describe("continuity config", () => {
  const CLASSIFIER = "typesafe/jev-latest";
  const OTHER_CLASSIFIER = "openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.13";
  const warnInvalidCapture = (which: "global" | "project", path: string) =>
    `navigate_tree: invalid continuity.capture in ${which} config at ${path} — expected true or false; falling back to the other layer's valid value, else the default true.`;
  const warnInvalidClassifier = (which: "global" | "project", path: string) =>
    `navigate_tree: invalid continuity.intentClassifier in ${which} config at ${path} — expected "provider/id" of a classifier model or a disable sentinel (null, false, "off", "disabled"); falling back to the other layer's valid value, else off (heuristics only).`;

  async function load(
    global: unknown,
    project?: unknown,
    projectTrusted = true,
  ) {
    const reader = readerFor({
      ...(global === undefined
        ? {}
        : { [GLOBAL_PATH]: JSON.stringify(global) }),
      ...(project === undefined
        ? {}
        : { [PROJECT_PATH]: JSON.stringify(project) }),
    });
    const out = await loadTreeNavigatorConfig({
      agentDir: AGENT_DIR,
      projectPath: PROJECT_PATH,
      projectTrusted,
      readFile: reader.readFile,
    });
    return { continuity: out.config.continuity, warnings: out.warnings };
  }

  it("defaults to capture on and heuristics only", async () => {
    assert.deepEqual(await load(undefined), {
      continuity: { capture: true, intentClassifier: null },
      warnings: [],
    });
  });

  it("reads both keys, camelCase and snake_case", async () => {
    assert.deepEqual(
      await load({
        continuity: { capture: false, intentClassifier: CLASSIFIER },
      }),
      {
        continuity: { capture: false, intentClassifier: CLASSIFIER },
        warnings: [],
      },
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      await load({
        continuity: { intent_classifier: ` ${OTHER_CLASSIFIER} ` },
      }),
      {
        continuity: { capture: true, intentClassifier: OTHER_CLASSIFIER },
        warnings: [],
      },
    );
  });

  it("a trusted project overrides global per key; an untrusted one is not read", async () => {
    const global = {
      continuity: { capture: true, intentClassifier: CLASSIFIER },
    };
    const project = { continuity: { capture: false } };
    assert.deepEqual(await load(global, project), {
      continuity: { capture: false, intentClassifier: CLASSIFIER },
      warnings: [],
    });
    assert.deepEqual(await load(global, project, false), {
      continuity: { capture: true, intentClassifier: CLASSIFIER },
      warnings: [],
    });
  });

  for (const sentinel of [null, false, "off", " OFF ", "disabled"]) {
    it(`${JSON.stringify(sentinel)} disables a classifier set by the other layer`, async () => {
      const out = await load(
        { continuity: { intentClassifier: CLASSIFIER } },
        { continuity: { intentClassifier: sentinel } },
      );
      assert.deepEqual(out, {
        continuity: { capture: true, intentClassifier: null },
        warnings: [],
      });
    });
  }

  it("an invalid project value warns and falls back to global, per key", async () => {
    const out = await load(
      { continuity: { capture: false, intentClassifier: CLASSIFIER } },
      { continuity: { capture: "yes", intentClassifier: "no-slash" } },
    );
    assert.deepEqual(out, {
      continuity: { capture: false, intentClassifier: CLASSIFIER },
      warnings: [
        warnInvalidCapture("project", PROJECT_PATH),
        warnInvalidClassifier("project", PROJECT_PATH),
      ],
    });
  });

  it("an invalid value with no valid layer warns and uses the default", async () => {
    const out = await load({
      continuity: { capture: 1, intentClassifier: true },
    });
    assert.deepEqual(out, {
      continuity: { capture: true, intentClassifier: null },
      warnings: [
        warnInvalidCapture("global", GLOBAL_PATH),
        warnInvalidClassifier("global", GLOBAL_PATH),
      ],
    });
  });

  for (const bad of ["", "provider/", "/id", "has space/id", 5, []]) {
    it(`rejects intentClassifier ${JSON.stringify(bad)}`, async () => {
      const out = await load({ continuity: { intentClassifier: bad } });
      assert.equal(out.continuity.intentClassifier, null);
      assert.deepEqual(out.warnings, [
        warnInvalidClassifier("global", GLOBAL_PATH),
      ]);
    });
  }

  it("a non-object continuity block warns and is ignored", async () => {
    const out = await load(
      { continuity: { capture: false } },
      { continuity: "off" },
    );
    assert.deepEqual(out, {
      continuity: { capture: false, intentClassifier: null },
      warnings: [
        `navigate_tree: continuity in project config at ${PROJECT_PATH} must be an object — ignored.`,
      ],
    });
  });
});

      },
      auto_navigate: { enabled: true, tools: { read: "omit" } },
    }),
    [PROJECT_PATH]: JSON.stringify({
      anchorStartAfterTurns: 3,
      treeProposal: { tools: { bash: "calls-only" } },
    }),
  };

  function load(runtime?: Record<string, unknown>, projectTrusted = true) {
    return loadTreeNavigatorConfig({
      agentDir: AGENT_DIR,
      projectPath: PROJECT_PATH,

  it("overrides scalars, maps and tool policy per key without losing lower keys", async () => {
    const out = await load({
      anchorStartAfterTurns: 8,
      modelOverrides: { [DEEPSEEK]: { rewindHintReserveTokens: 60000 } },
      treeProposal: { tools: { read: "full", write: "omit" } },
      auto_navigate: { tools: { bash: "calls-only" }, check_every_turns: 2 },
    });
    assert.deepEqual(out.warnings, []);
    assert.equal(out.config.anchorStartAfterTurns, 8);
    assert.equal(out.config.parentHandoffMode, "synthesized");
    assert.equal(out.config.rewindHintReserveTokens, 50000);
    assert.equal(resolveRewindHintReserve(out.config, DEEPSEEK), 60000);
    assert.equal(resolveRewindHintReserve(out.config, HAIKU), 20000);
    assert.deepEqual(out.config.proposal, {
      model: "test/model:high",
      tools: {
        read: "full",
        grep: "calls-only",
        bash: "calls-only",
        write: "omit",
      },
    });
    assert.deepEqual(out.config.autoNavigate, {
      enabled: true,
      tools: { read: "omit", bash: "calls-only" },
      checkEveryTurns: 2,
    });

      capture: true,
      intentClassifier: "typesafe/jev-latest",
    });
  });

  it("can disable capture and a classifier set by the files", async () => {
    const out = await load({
      continuity: { capture: false, intentClassifier: "off" },
    });
    assert.deepEqual(out.warnings, []);
    assert.deepEqual(out.config.continuity, {
      capture: false,
      intentClassifier: null,
    });
  });

  it("applies even when the project is untrusted", async () => {
    const out = await load({ anchorStartAfterTurns: 8 }, false);

      read: "omit",
      grep: "calls-only",
    });

  it("an empty runtime root resolves like no runtime layer", async () => {
    assert.deepEqual(await load({}), await load());
  });

  it("clearing restores file resolution and sessions stay isolated", async () => {
    writeRuntimeConfig("layer-a", { continuity: { capture: false } });
    writeRuntimeConfig("layer-b", { anchorStartAfterTurns: 9 });
    const files = await load();
    const a = await load(readRuntimeConfig("layer-a"));
    const b = await load(readRuntimeConfig("layer-b"));
    assert.equal(a.config.continuity.capture, false);
    assert.equal(a.config.anchorStartAfterTurns, 3);
    assert.equal(b.config.continuity.capture, true);
    assert.equal(b.config.anchorStartAfterTurns, 9);
    clearRuntimeConfig("layer-a");
    assert.deepEqual(await load(readRuntimeConfig("layer-a")), files);
    assert.equal(
      (await load(readRuntimeConfig("layer-b"))).config.anchorStartAfterTurns,
      9,
    );
    clearRuntimeConfig("layer-b");
  });

  it("invalid runtime values fail closed with runtime-scoped warnings", async () => {
    const out = await load({
      treeProposal: { tools: { read: "omti" } },
      auto_navigate: { check_every_turns: 0 },
      continuity: { capture: "yes" },
      rewindHintReserveTokens: 5,

    assert.equal(out.warnings.length, 4);

      assert.match(warning, /in runtime config /);
    }
  });

  it("a valid runtime proposal cannot clear an invalid file proposal", async () => {
    const out = await loadTreeNavigatorConfig({
      agentDir: AGENT_DIR,
      projectPath: PROJECT_PATH,
      projectTrusted: false,
      readFile: readerFor({
        [GLOBAL_PATH]: JSON.stringify({
          treeProposal: { tools: { read: "omti" } },
        }),

      runtime: { treeProposal: { tools: { read: "full" } } },

    assert.match(out.config.proposalError ?? "", /read/);
  });

  it("a non-object runtime root is ignored with a warning", async () => {
    const out = await load("nope" as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
    assert.deepEqual(out.config, (await load()).config);
    assert.deepEqual(out.warnings, [
      "navigate_tree: runtime config must be a JSON object — that layer was ignored.",
    ]);
  });

describe("parseContinuityDelta", () => {
  const block = (body: string) =>
    `<${CONTINUITY_DELTA_TAG}>${body}</${CONTINUITY_DELTA_TAG}>`;
  const malformed = (e: unknown) =>
    e instanceof ContinuityError && e.code === "invalid_delta";

  it("returns undefined without a block", () => {
    assert.equal(
      parseContinuityDelta("## Goal\nDone. No ledger changes."),
      undefined,
    );
  });

  it("ignores prose around the block and accepts a fenced body", () => {
    const text = `## Summary\nWe ported the lexer {not json}.\n\n${block('\n```json\n{"completed":["S2"],"expiredSteering":["T6"],"ratified":[{"kind":"fact","text":"Lexer is table driven"}]}\n```\n')}\n\nNext: parser. [1] done`;
    assert.deepEqual(parseContinuityDelta(text), {
      completed: ["S2"],
      expiredSteering: ["T6"],
      ratified: [{ kind: "fact", text: "Lexer is table driven" }],
    });
    assert.deepEqual(parseContinuityDelta(block("{}")), {});
  });

  const bad: [string, string][] = [
    ["invalid JSON", block('{"completed": ["S2",]}')],
    ["a non-object body", block('["S2"]')],
    ["an unclosed tag", `text <${CONTINUITY_DELTA_TAG}>{"completed":[]}`],
    ["two blocks", block("{}") + block("{}")],
    ["an unknown key", block('{"remove":["R1"]}')],
    ["a bad id list", block('{"completed":"S2"}')],
    ["an unknown kind", block('{"ratified":[{"kind":"wish","text":"x"}]}')],
    ["a missing superseding item", block('{"superseded":[{"ids":["R1"]}]}')],
  ];
  for (const [name, text] of bad) {
    it(`rejects ${name}`, () => {
      assert.throws(() => parseContinuityDelta(text), malformed);
    });
  }
});

describe("extractContinuityDelta", () => {

describe("supersession and objectives", () => {
  const tabs = "Always indent with tabs in this repo.";
  const spaces = "Scratch that: spaces from now on, not tabs.";
  const branch = [user("u1", tabs), filler("f1"), user("u2", spaces)];
  const seeded = apply(createLedger(), [
    {
      op: { op: "add", kind: "rule", text: tabs, quote: tabs },
      ctx: { origin: "user", entryId: "u1" },
    },
  ]).ledger;

  it("emits a supersede that cites the new message and the ledger accepts it", async () => {
    const result = await captureIntent(
      branch,
      undefined,
      seeded,
      scripted({ [spaces]: verdict("rule", ["R1"]) }),
    );
    assert.equal(result.ops.length, 1);
    const [{ op, ctx }] = result.ops;
    assert.deepEqual(op, {
      op: "supersede",
      ids: ["R1"],
      with: { kind: "rule", text: spaces, quote: spaces },
      citedEntryId: "u2",
    });
    const { ledger, effects } = apply(seeded, result.ops);
    assert.deepEqual(effects, ["superseded"]);
    assert.deepEqual(
      ledger.items.map((i) => [i.id, i.status, i.source]),
      [
        ["R1", "superseded", { entryId: "u1", origin: "user" }],
        ["R2", "active", { entryId: "u2", origin: "user" }],
      ],
    );

    const ownSource = applyOps(
      seeded,
      [{ ...(op as object), citedEntryId: "u1" } as typeof op],
      ctx,
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      ownSource.rejected.map((r) => r.reason.code),
      ["invalid_citation"],
    );
  });

  it("drops named ids that are unknown, inactive or of another kind", async () => {
    const withDecision = apply(seeded, [
      {
        op: { op: "add", kind: "decision", text: "Use sqlite for the index" },
        ctx: { origin: "user", entryId: "u0" },
      },
    ]).ledger;
    for (const named of [["R9"], ["D2"]]) {
      const result = await captureIntent(
        branch,
        "u1",
        withDecision,
        scripted({ [spaces]: verdict("rule", named) }),
      );
      assert.deepEqual(
        result.ops.map((c) => c.op.op),
        ["add"],
      );
    }
  });

  it("keeps a single active objective: downgrades to a sub-goal unless the classifier named it", async () => {
    const goal = "Goal: ship the continuity ledger end to end";
    const other = "New goal: also redesign the tree panel";
    const replace = "Actually the real goal is shipping capture first";
    const withObjective = apply(createLedger(), [
      {
        op: { op: "add", kind: "objective", text: goal },
        ctx: { origin: "user", entryId: "u0" },
      },
    ]).ledger;

    const downgraded = await captureIntent(
      [user("u1", other)],
      undefined,
      withObjective,
      scripted({ [other]: verdict("objective") }),
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      downgraded.ops.map((c) => c.op),
      [{ op: "add", kind: "sub-goal", text: other, quote: other }],
    );

    const replaced = await captureIntent(
      [user("u1", replace)],
      undefined,
      withObjective,
      scripted({ [replace]: verdict("objective", ["G1"]) }),
    );
    const out = apply(withObjective, replaced.ops);
    assert.deepEqual(out.rejected, []);
    assert.deepEqual(
      active(out.ledger).map((i) => [i.kind, i.text]),
      [["objective", replace]],
    );

    const twoNew = await captureIntent(
      [user("u1", goal), user("u2", other)],
      undefined,
      createLedger(),
      scripted({ [goal]: verdict("objective"), [other]: verdict("objective") }),
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      twoNew.ops.map((c) => c.op.op === "add" && c.op.kind),
      ["objective", "sub-goal"],

describe("createModelClassifier", () => {
  type Registry = Pick<ModelRegistry, "getModelOfType" | "classify">;

  const answer = (choice: string, confidence = 0.95) => ({
    type: "choice" as const,
    choice,
    probabilities: {},
    confidence,
  });

  function fakeRegistry(
    respond: (context: ClassifierContext) => Partial<ClassifierResult> | Error,
    known = ["typesafe/jev-latest"],
  ) {
    const calls: { context: ClassifierContext; signal?: AbortSignal }[] = [];
    const registry = {
      getModelOfType: (_type: string, provider: string, id: string) =>
        known.includes(`${provider}/${id}`) ? { provider, id } : undefined,
      classify: async (
        _model: unknown,
        context: ClassifierContext,
        options?: { signal?: AbortSignal },
      ) => {
        calls.push({ context, signal: options?.signal });
        const out = respond(context);
        if (out instanceof Error) throw out;
        return {
          api: "test",
          provider: "typesafe",
          model: "jev-latest",
          answers: {},
          stopReason: "stop",
          timestamp: 0,
          ...out,
        } as ClassifierResult;
      },
    } as unknown as Registry;
    return { registry, calls };
  }

  const input = (over: Partial<IntentInput> = {}): IntentInput => ({
    entryId: "u1",
    text: "From now on use spaces, not tabs.",
    activeItems: [{ id: "R1", kind: "rule", text: "Use tabs" }],
    ...over,
  });

  async function make(
    respond: Parameters<typeof fakeRegistry>[0],
    opts?: { minConfidence?: number },
  ) {
    const fake = fakeRegistry(respond);
    const classifier = await createModelClassifier(
      fake.registry,
      "typesafe/jev-latest",
      opts,
    );
    assert.ok(classifier);
    return { classifier, calls: fake.calls };
  }

  it("asks the kind and the contradicted item, and returns the verdict", async () => {
    const { classifier, calls } = await make(() => ({
      answers: { kind: answer("rule"), contradicts: answer("R1") },
    }));
    const out = await classifier(input({ activeAnchor: "impl" }));
    assert.deepEqual(out, {
      kind: "rule",
      supersedes: ["R1"],
      by: "classifier",
    });
    const [{ context }] = calls;
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(context.questions), ["kind", "contradicts"]);
    const kind = context.questions.kind;
    assert.equal(kind?.type, "choice");
    assert.deepEqual(
      kind && Object.keys(kind.criteria as Record<string, string>),
      [...INTENT_KINDS],
    );
    assert.deepEqual(context.questions.contradicts?.criteria, {
      R1: "Use tabs",
      none: "The message changes none of the items",
    });
    assert.deepEqual(context.state, {
      message: "From now on use spaces, not tabs.",
      activeAnchor: "impl",
      activeItems: [{ id: "R1", kind: "rule", text: "Use tabs" }],
    });
  });

  it("answers 'none' and unknown ids add no supersession; an ephemeral kind stays ephemeral", async () => {
    const none = await make(() => ({
      answers: { kind: answer("decision"), contradicts: answer("none") },
    }));
    assert.deepEqual(await none.classifier(input()), {
      kind: "decision",
      by: "classifier",
    });

    const bogus = await make(() => ({
      answers: { kind: answer("rule"), contradicts: answer("R77") },
    }));
    assert.deepEqual(await bogus.classifier(input()), {
      kind: "rule",
      by: "classifier",
    });

    const chatter = await make(() => ({
      answers: { kind: answer("ephemeral"), contradicts: answer("R1") },
    }));
    assert.deepEqual(await chatter.classifier(input()), {
      kind: "ephemeral",
      by: "classifier",
    });
  });

  it("skips the contradiction question when there are no active items", async () => {
    const { classifier, calls } = await make(() => ({
      answers: { kind: answer("rule") },
    }));
    await classifier(input({ activeItems: [] }));
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(calls[0]?.context.questions ?? {}), ["kind"]);
  });

  it("treats a low-confidence answer as ephemeral, without a warning", async () => {
    const { classifier } = await make(() => ({
      answers: { kind: answer("rule", 0.69), contradicts: answer("R1") },
    }));
    assert.deepEqual(await classifier(input()), {
      kind: "ephemeral",
      by: "classifier",
    });
  });

  it("honors a custom minConfidence", async () => {
    const { classifier } = await make(
      () => ({ answers: { kind: answer("rule", 0.5) } }),
      { minConfidence: 0.4 },
    );
    assert.equal((await classifier(input())).kind, "rule");
  });

  it("a provider error falls back to the heuristic verdict with one warning, and the instance stops calling the model", async () => {
    const { classifier, calls } = await make(() => ({

/**
 * Session Continuity Ledger: structured user intent that survives folds.
 *
 * Pure data model, reducer, invariants and (de)serialization. The ledger is
 * stored on `branch_summary.details[LEDGER_DETAILS_KEY]`, so it follows the
 * active branch across /tree and fork. Capture (reading session entries,
 * classifiers) and rendering live elsewhere.
 *
 * No I/O and no pi runtime imports. Every update returns a new ledger.
 */

import { isValidName } from "./helpers.ts";

export const LEDGER_DETAILS_KEY = "continuity";
export const LEDGER_VERSION = 1;

// Caps are explicit: oversize text is truncated with a visible marker, and a
// full ledger rejects further additions instead of dropping anything.
export const MAX_ITEM_TEXT_CHARS = 500;
export const MAX_QUOTE_CHARS = 400;
export const MAX_PATH_CHARS = 512;
export const MAX_LEDGER_ITEMS = 200;
export const TRUNCATION_MARKER = "…[truncated]";

export const ITEM_KINDS = [
  "objective",
  "sub-goal",
  "rule",
  "decision",
  "steering",
  "fact",
  "file",
] as const;
export const ITEM_STATUSES = [
  "active",
  "completed",
  "superseded",
  "archived",
  "stale",
] as const;
export const ITEM_ORIGINS = [
  "user",
  "ask_user",
  "pin",
  "agent",
  "classifier",
] as const;

export type ItemKind = (typeof ITEM_KINDS)[number];
export type ItemStatus = (typeof ITEM_STATUSES)[number];
export type ItemOrigin = (typeof ITEM_ORIGINS)[number];

const ID_PREFIX: Readonly<Record<ItemKind, string>> = {
  objective: "G",
  "sub-goal": "S",
  rule: "R",
  decision: "D",
  steering: "T",
  fact: "F",
  file: "P",
};
const ID_RE = /^[GSRDTFP][1-9]\d*$/;
const LINES_RE = /^\d+(-\d+)?$/;
const SHA256_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;

const USER_ORIGINS: ReadonlySet<ItemOrigin> = new Set([
  "user",
  "ask_user",
  "pin",
]);
const PROTECTED_KINDS: ReadonlySet<ItemKind> = new Set([
  "objective",
  "rule",
  "decision",
]);

export type ContinuityErrorCode =
  | "invalid_ledger"
  | "unsupported_version"
  | "invalid_op"
  | "invalid_delta"
  | "unknown_item"
  | "protected_item"
  | "invalid_citation"
  | "wrong_kind"
  | "not_live"
  | "ledger_full";

/** Typed failure for parsing, validation and rejected ledger operations. */
export class ContinuityError extends Error {
  readonly code: ContinuityErrorCode;
  readonly itemId?: string;
  constructor(code: ContinuityErrorCode, message: string, itemId?: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ContinuityError";
    this.code = code;
    if (itemId !== undefined) this.itemId = itemId;
  }
}

/** Pointer to a file the user or agent cares about; `sha256` enables staleness checks. */
export interface FilePointer {
  readonly path: string;
  /** `N` or `N-M`. */
  readonly lines?: string;
  readonly sha256?: string;
  readonly why: string;
}

export interface ItemSource {
  readonly entryId?: string;
  readonly origin: ItemOrigin;
}

export interface LedgerItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly kind: ItemKind;
  /** For `file` items this is derived: `path[:lines]`. */
  readonly text: string;
  readonly status: ItemStatus;
  readonly source: ItemSource;
  /** The user's exact words, capped. */
  readonly quote?: string;
  /** Anchor name; required for `steering`, optional for `sub-goal`. */
  readonly scopeAnchor?: string;
  readonly file?: FilePointer;
  readonly supersedes?: readonly string[];
  readonly supersededBy?: string;
  /** Set by a user-origin pin; protects any kind from agent/classifier ops. */
  readonly pinned?: true;
  readonly createdRev: number;
  readonly updatedRev: number;
}

export interface Ledger {
  readonly version: typeof LEDGER_VERSION;
  readonly rev: number;
  /** Monotonic id counter. Ids are never reused within a lineage. */
  readonly nextId: number;
  readonly items: readonly LedgerItem[];
}

/** Fields of an item to create. `text` is required except for `file` items, where it is derived. */
export interface NewItem {
  readonly kind: ItemKind;
  readonly text?: string;
  readonly quote?: string;
  readonly scopeAnchor?: string;
  readonly file?: FilePointer;
}

export type LedgerOp =
  | ({ readonly op: "add" } & NewItem)
  | {
      readonly op: "update";
      readonly id: string;
      readonly text?: string;
      readonly quote?: string;
      readonly file?: FilePointer;
    }
  | {
      readonly op: "supersede";
      readonly ids: readonly string[];
      readonly with: NewItem;
      readonly citedEntryId?: string;
    }
  | {
      readonly op: "archive";
      readonly id: string;
      readonly expectKind?: ItemKind;
    }
  | { readonly op: "complete"; readonly id: string }
  | { readonly op: "markStale"; readonly id: string }
  | { readonly op: "pin"; readonly id: string }
  | { readonly op: "unpin"; readonly id: string };

/** Who performs an op. Authority depends on `origin`; the ledger cannot verify entries itself. */
export interface OpContext {
  readonly origin: ItemOrigin;
  /** Session entry that caused this op; recorded as the new item's source. */
  readonly entryId?: string;
  /**
   * Position of a user-authored entry on the active branch, or undefined when the
   * entry is not a user message. Used to verify supersession citations.
   */
  readonly userEntryIndex?: (entryId: string) => number | undefined;
}

export type OpEffect =
  | "added"
  | "updated"
  | "superseded"
  | "archived"
  | "completed"
  | "stale"
  | "pinned"
  | "unpinned"
  | "duplicate";

export interface AppliedOp {
  readonly op: LedgerOp;
  readonly effect: OpEffect;
  /** Item after the op: the new item for `added`/`superseded`, the existing one for `duplicate`. */
  readonly item: LedgerItem;
}

export interface RejectedOp {
  readonly op: LedgerOp;
  readonly reason: ContinuityError;
}

export interface ReduceResult {
  readonly ledger: Ledger;
  readonly applied: readonly AppliedOp[];
  readonly rejected: readonly RejectedOp[];
  /** Dead items dropped to stay under the item cap, oldest first. */
  readonly evicted: readonly string[];
}

export interface DeltaSupersession {
  readonly ids: readonly string[];
  readonly with: NewItem;
  readonly citedEntryId?: string;
}

/** Model-proposed ledger changes emitted at fold time. */
export interface ContinuityDelta {
  readonly completed?: readonly string[];
  readonly ratified?: readonly NewItem[];
  readonly superseded?: readonly DeltaSupersession[];
  readonly expiredSteering?: readonly string[];
}

export interface FoldContext {
  /** The anchor being folded; its active steering is archived. */
  readonly anchorName: string;
  readonly origin: "agent" | "classifier";
  readonly entryId?: string;
  readonly userEntryIndex?: (entryId: string) => number | undefined;
}

export const isUserOrigin = (origin: ItemOrigin): boolean =>
  USER_ORIGINS.has(origin);

/** Protected items cannot be changed by agent/classifier ops. */
export function isProtected(item: LedgerItem): boolean {
  return (
    item.pinned === true ||
    (PROTECTED_KINDS.has(item.kind) && USER_ORIGINS.has(item.source.origin))
  );
}

export function createLedger(): Ledger {
  return { version: LEDGER_VERSION, rev: 0, nextId: 1, items: [] };
}

export function capText(text: string, max: number): string {
  if (text.length <= max) return text;
  let cut = text.slice(0, max - TRUNCATION_MARKER.length);
  const last = cut.charCodeAt(cut.length - 1);
  if (last >= 0xd800 && last <= 0xdbff) cut = cut.slice(0, -1);
  return cut + TRUNCATION_MARKER;
}

export function normalizeText(text: string): string {
  return text.normalize("NFKC").toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

const locator = (file: FilePointer): string =>
  file.lines ? `${file.path}:${file.lines}` : file.path;

const invalid = (message: string, itemId?: string): ContinuityError =>
  new ContinuityError("invalid_op", message, itemId);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Reducer
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface Work {
  items: LedgerItem[];
  nextId: number;
  /** Revision stamped on everything this transaction touches. */
  rev: number;
  changed: boolean;
  applied: AppliedOp[];
  rejected: RejectedOp[];
  evicted: string[];
}

// Deterministic operations (fold-time archiving, hash checks) carry no extra authority.
const SYSTEM_CTX: OpContext = { origin: "agent" };

const begin = (ledger: Ledger): Work => ({
  items: [...ledger.items],
  nextId: ledger.nextId,
  rev: ledger.rev + 1,
  changed: false,
  applied: [],
  rejected: [],
  evicted: [],
});

function finish(base: Ledger, work: Work): ReduceResult {
  const ledger: Ledger = work.changed
    ? {
        version: LEDGER_VERSION,
        rev: work.rev,
        nextId: work.nextId,
        items: work.items,
      }
    : base;
  return {
    ledger,
    applied: work.applied,
    rejected: work.rejected,
    evicted: work.evicted,
  };
}

function find(work: Work, id: string): LedgerItem {
  const item = work.items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
  if (!item) {
    throw new ContinuityError("unknown_item", `unknown ledger item ${id}`, id);
  }
  return item;
}

function replace(work: Work, item: LedgerItem): void {
  work.items = work.items.map((candidate) =>
    candidate.id === item.id ? item : candidate,
  );
}

function requireStatus(
  item: LedgerItem,
  allowed: readonly ItemStatus[],
  verb: string,
): void {
  if (!allowed.includes(item.status)) {
    throw new ContinuityError(
      "not_live",
      `cannot ${verb} ${item.id}: it is ${item.status}`,
      item.id,
    );
  }
}

function guardProtected(item: LedgerItem, ctx: OpContext, verb: string): void {
  if (isProtected(item) && !USER_ORIGINS.has(ctx.origin)) {
    throw new ContinuityError(
      "protected_item",
      `${item.id} (${item.kind}, ${item.source.origin}) is protected: ${ctx.origin} ops cannot ${verb} it`,
      item.id,
    );
  }
}

function checkCitation(
  item: LedgerItem,
  cited: string | undefined,
  ctx: OpContext,
): void {
  const reject = (why: string) =>
    new ContinuityError(
      "invalid_citation",
      `superseding protected item ${item.id} ${why}`,
      item.id,
    );
  if (!cited) throw reject("requires citing a newer user entry");
  const index = ctx.userEntryIndex?.(cited);
  const selfCited = USER_ORIGINS.has(ctx.origin) && cited === ctx.entryId;
  if (index === undefined && !selfCited) {
    throw reject(`cites ${cited}, which is not a known user entry`);
  }
  const own = item.source.entryId;
  if (own === undefined) return;
  if (cited === own) throw reject(`cites its own source entry ${cited}`);
  // An unresolvable own entry was folded off the active branch, so it is older.
  const ownIndex = ctx.userEntryIndex?.(own);
  if (index !== undefined && ownIndex !== undefined && index <= ownIndex) {
    throw reject(`cites ${cited}, which is not newer than ${own}`);
  }
}

interface Normalized {
  readonly kind: ItemKind;
  readonly text: string;
  readonly quote?: string;
  readonly scopeAnchor?: string;
  readonly file?: FilePointer;
}

function capRequired(value: unknown, max: number, label: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.trim().length === 0) {
    throw invalid(`${label} must be a non-empty string`);
  }
  return capText(value.trim(), max);
}

function normalizeFile(file: FilePointer): FilePointer {
  if (
    typeof file.path !== "string" ||
    file.path.length === 0 ||
    file.path.length > MAX_PATH_CHARS
  ) {
    throw invalid(`file.path must be 1-${MAX_PATH_CHARS} characters`);
  }
  if (file.lines !== undefined && !LINES_RE.test(file.lines)) {
    throw invalid("file.lines must be N or N-M");
  }
  if (file.sha256 !== undefined && !SHA256_RE.test(file.sha256)) {
    throw invalid("file.sha256 must be 64 lowercase hex characters");
  }
  return {
    path: file.path,
    ...(file.lines !== undefined && { lines: file.lines }),
    ...(file.sha256 !== undefined && { sha256: file.sha256 }),
    why: capRequired(file.why, MAX_ITEM_TEXT_CHARS, "file.why"),
  };
}

function normalizeNewItem(input: NewItem): Normalized {
  const { kind } = input;
  if (!ITEM_KINDS.includes(kind)) throw invalid(`unknown kind ${String(kind)}`);
  const quote =
    input.quote === undefined
      ? undefined
      : capRequired(input.quote, MAX_QUOTE_CHARS, "quote");
  const { scopeAnchor } = input;
  if (kind === "steering" && scopeAnchor === undefined) {
    throw invalid("steering requires a scopeAnchor");
  }
  if (scopeAnchor !== undefined) {
    if (kind !== "steering" && kind !== "sub-goal") {
      throw invalid(`${kind} items cannot have a scopeAnchor`);
    }
    if (!isValidName(scopeAnchor)) {
      throw invalid(`scopeAnchor ${String(scopeAnchor)} is not an anchor name`);
    }
  }
  const common = {
    kind,
    ...(quote !== undefined && { quote }),
    ...(scopeAnchor !== undefined && { scopeAnchor }),
  };
  if (kind === "file") {
    if (input.text !== undefined) throw invalid("file text is derived");
    if (!input.file) throw invalid("file items require a file pointer");
    const file = normalizeFile(input.file);
    return { ...common, text: locator(file), file };
  }
  if (input.file !== undefined)
    throw invalid(`${kind} items cannot have a file`);
  return {
    ...common,
    text: capRequired(input.text, MAX_ITEM_TEXT_CHARS, "text"),
  };
}

const DEAD_STATUSES: ReadonlySet<ItemStatus> = new Set([
  "archived",
  "completed",
  "superseded",
]);

/**
 * Drop the oldest dead item, with the items it superseded (the lineage check
 * needs both ends), and unlink it from its heir. Active and stale items stay.
 */
function evictOldestDead(work: Work): boolean {
  const oldest = work.items.find((item) => DEAD_STATUSES.has(item.status));
  if (!oldest) return false;
  const drop = new Set<string>();
  const collect = (item: LedgerItem): void => {
    if (drop.has(item.id)) return;
    drop.add(item.id);
    for (const id of item.supersedes ?? []) {
      const older = work.items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
      if (older) collect(older);
    }
  };
  collect(oldest);
  work.items = work.items
    .filter((item) => !drop.has(item.id))
    .map((item) => {
      const kept = item.supersedes?.filter((id) => !drop.has(id));
      if (!kept || kept.length === item.supersedes?.length) return item;
      const { supersedes: _dropped, ...rest } = item;
      return kept.length > 0 ? { ...rest, supersedes: kept } : rest;
    });
  work.evicted.push(...drop);
  return true;
}

function create(
  work: Work,
  fields: Normalized,
  ctx: OpContext,
  supersedes: readonly LedgerItem[],
  source?: ItemSource,
): LedgerItem {
  while (work.items.length >= MAX_LEDGER_ITEMS) {
    if (!evictOldestDead(work)) {
      throw new ContinuityError(
        "ledger_full",
        `ledger holds ${MAX_LEDGER_ITEMS} active items; archive or complete one before adding another`,
      );
    }
  }
  const pinned = ctx.origin === "pin" || supersedes.some((old) => old.pinned);
  const item: LedgerItem = {
    id: `${ID_PREFIX[fields.kind]}${work.nextId}`,
    kind: fields.kind,
    text: fields.text,
    status: "active",
    source: source ?? {
      ...(ctx.entryId !== undefined && { entryId: ctx.entryId }),
      origin: ctx.origin,
    },
    ...(fields.quote !== undefined && { quote: fields.quote }),
    ...(fields.scopeAnchor !== undefined && {
      scopeAnchor: fields.scopeAnchor,
    }),
    ...(fields.file !== undefined && { file: fields.file }),
    ...(supersedes.length > 0 && { supersedes: supersedes.map((o) => o.id) }),
    ...(pinned && { pinned: true as const }),
    createdRev: work.rev,
    updatedRev: work.rev,
  };
  work.nextId += 1;
  work.items.push(item);
  return item;
}

function applyAdd(work: Work, op: LedgerOp & { op: "add" }, ctx: OpContext) {
  const fields = normalizeNewItem(op);
  const key = normalizeText(fields.text);
  const existing = work.items.find(
    (item) =>
      item.status === "active" &&
      item.kind === fields.kind &&
      normalizeText(item.text) === key,
  );
  if (existing) return applied(op, "duplicate", existing);
  if (
    fields.kind === "objective" &&
    work.items.some((i) => i.kind === "objective" && i.status === "active")
  ) {
    throw invalid("an active objective exists; supersede it instead");
  }
  return applied(op, "added", create(work, fields, ctx, []));
}

function applyUpdate(
  work: Work,
  op: LedgerOp & { op: "update" },
  ctx: OpContext,
) {
  const item = find(work, op.id);
  guardProtected(item, ctx, "rewrite");
  requireStatus(item, ["active", "stale"], "update");
  if (op.text === undefined && op.quote === undefined && !op.file) {
    throw invalid("update needs text, quote or file", item.id);
  }
  let next: LedgerItem = item;
  if (op.text !== undefined) {
    if (item.kind === "file") throw invalid("file text is derived", item.id);
    next = { ...next, text: capRequired(op.text, MAX_ITEM_TEXT_CHARS, "text") };
  }
  if (op.file !== undefined) {
    if (item.kind !== "file")
      throw invalid("only file items take a file", item.id);
    const file = normalizeFile(op.file);
    next = { ...next, text: locator(file), file, status: "active" };
  }
  if (op.quote !== undefined) {
    next = { ...next, quote: capRequired(op.quote, MAX_QUOTE_CHARS, "quote") };
  }
  next = { ...next, updatedRev: work.rev };
  replace(work, next);
  return applied(op, "updated", next);
}

function applySupersede(
  work: Work,
  op: LedgerOp & { op: "supersede" },
  ctx: OpContext,
) {
  if (op.ids.length === 0 || new Set(op.ids).size !== op.ids.length) {
    throw invalid("supersede needs one or more distinct ids");
  }
  const olds = op.ids.map((id) => find(work, id));
  const fields = normalizeNewItem(op.with);
  const cited =
    op.citedEntryId ?? (USER_ORIGINS.has(ctx.origin) ? ctx.entryId : undefined);
  for (const old of olds) {
    requireStatus(old, ["active", "stale"], "supersede");
    if (old.kind !== fields.kind) {
      throw new ContinuityError(
        "wrong_kind",
        `${old.id} is a ${old.kind}; its replacement must be one too, not a ${fields.kind}`,
        old.id,
      );
    }
    if (isProtected(old)) checkCitation(old, cited, ctx);
  }
  // A protected item's replacement keeps its authority: the cited user entry is the source.
  const heir = olds.find(isProtected);
  const source: ItemSource | undefined = heir && {
    ...(cited !== undefined && { entryId: cited }),
    origin: heir.source.origin,
  };
  const created = create(work, fields, ctx, olds, source);
  for (const old of olds) {
    replace(work, {
      ...old,
      status: "superseded",
      supersededBy: created.id,
      updatedRev: work.rev,
    });
  }
  return applied(op, "superseded", created);
}

function applyArchive(
  work: Work,
  op: LedgerOp & { op: "archive" },
  ctx: OpContext,
) {
  const item = find(work, op.id);
  guardProtected(item, ctx, "archive");
  if (op.expectKind !== undefined && item.kind !== op.expectKind) {
    throw new ContinuityError(
      "wrong_kind",
      `${item.id} is a ${item.kind}, not ${op.expectKind}`,
      item.id,
    );
  }
  requireStatus(item, ["active", "stale", "completed"], "archive");
  const next = { ...item, status: "archived" as const, updatedRev: work.rev };
  replace(work, next);
  return applied(op, "archived", next);
}

function applyComplete(
  work: Work,
  op: LedgerOp & { op: "complete" },
  ctx: OpContext,
) {
  const item = find(work, op.id);
  guardProtected(item, ctx, "complete");
  if (item.kind !== "objective" && item.kind !== "sub-goal") {
    throw new ContinuityError(
      "wrong_kind",
      `${item.id} is a ${item.kind}; only goals can be completed`,
      item.id,
    );
  }
  requireStatus(item, ["active"], "complete");
  const next = { ...item, status: "completed" as const, updatedRev: work.rev };
  replace(work, next);
  return applied(op, "completed", next);
}

function applyMarkStale(work: Work, op: LedgerOp & { op: "markStale" }) {
  const item = find(work, op.id);
  if (item.kind !== "file") {
    throw new ContinuityError(
      "wrong_kind",
      `${item.id} is a ${item.kind}; only file pointers go stale`,
      item.id,
    );
  }
  requireStatus(item, ["active"], "mark stale");
  const next = { ...item, status: "stale" as const, updatedRev: work.rev };
  replace(work, next);
  return applied(op, "stale", next);
}

function applyPin(
  work: Work,
  op: LedgerOp & { op: "pin" | "unpin" },
  ctx: OpContext,
) {
  const item = find(work, op.id);
  if (!USER_ORIGINS.has(ctx.origin)) {
    throw new ContinuityError(
      "protected_item",
      `${ctx.origin} ops cannot ${op.op} ${item.id}`,
      item.id,
    );
  }
  requireStatus(item, ["active", "stale", "completed"], op.op);
  if (op.op === "pin") {
    if (item.pinned) throw invalid(`${item.id} is already pinned`, item.id);
    const next = { ...item, pinned: true as const, updatedRev: work.rev };
    replace(work, next);
    return applied(op, "pinned", next);
  }
  if (!item.pinned) throw invalid(`${item.id} is not pinned`, item.id);
  const { pinned: _pinned, ...rest } = item;
  const next: LedgerItem = { ...rest, updatedRev: work.rev };
  replace(work, next);
  return applied(op, "unpinned", next);
}

const applied = (
  op: LedgerOp,
  effect: OpEffect,
  item: LedgerItem,
): AppliedOp => ({ op, effect, item });

function applyOne(work: Work, op: LedgerOp, ctx: OpContext): AppliedOp {
  switch (op.op) {
    case "add":
      return applyAdd(work, op, ctx);
    case "update":
      return applyUpdate(work, op, ctx);
    case "supersede":
      return applySupersede(work, op, ctx);
    case "archive":
      return applyArchive(work, op, ctx);
    case "complete":
      return applyComplete(work, op, ctx);
    case "markStale":
      return applyMarkStale(work, op);
    case "pin":
    case "unpin":
      return applyPin(work, op, ctx);
    default:
      throw invalid(`unknown op ${String((op as { op?: unknown }).op)}`);
  }
}

function runOps(work: Work, ops: readonly LedgerOp[], ctx: OpContext): void {
  for (const op of ops) {
    try {
      const result = applyOne(work, op, ctx);
      work.applied.push(result);
      if (result.effect !== "duplicate") work.changed = true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof ContinuityError)) throw error;
      work.rejected.push({ op, reason: error });
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Apply ops in order. Each op is atomic: a rejected op leaves the ledger as it was
 * and is reported in `rejected`; later ops still run. One call is one revision.
 */
export function applyOps(
  ledger: Ledger,
  ops: readonly LedgerOp[],
  ctx: OpContext,
): ReduceResult {
  const work = begin(ledger);
  runOps(work, ops, ctx);
  return finish(ledger, work);
}

const steeringArchiveOps = (
  items: readonly LedgerItem[],
  anchorName: string,
): LedgerOp[] =>
  items
    // Pinned steering was explicitly kept by the user, so a fold does not expire it.
    .filter(
      (item) =>
        item.kind === "steering" &&
        item.status === "active" &&
        item.scopeAnchor === anchorName &&
        !item.pinned,
    )
    .map((item) => ({
      op: "archive",
      id: item.id,
      expectKind: "steering",
    }));

/** Archive (never delete) active steering scoped to `anchorName`; each appears in `applied`. */
export function archiveSteeringForAnchor(
  ledger: Ledger,
  anchorName: string,
): ReduceResult {
  const work = begin(ledger);
  runOps(work, steeringArchiveOps(work.items, anchorName), SYSTEM_CTX);
  return finish(ledger, work);
}

function deltaOps(delta: ContinuityDelta): LedgerOp[] {
  return [
    ...(delta.expiredSteering ?? []).map(
      (id): LedgerOp => ({ op: "archive", id, expectKind: "steering" }),
    ),
    ...(delta.completed ?? []).map((id): LedgerOp => ({ op: "complete", id })),
    ...(delta.superseded ?? []).map(
      (entry): LedgerOp => ({
        op: "supersede",
        ids: entry.ids,
        with: entry.with,
        ...(entry.citedEntryId !== undefined && {
          citedEntryId: entry.citedEntryId,
        }),
      }),
    ),
    ...(delta.ratified ?? []).map((item): LedgerOp => ({ op: "add", ...item })),
  ];
}

/**
 * Reconcile a model-proposed delta through the normal invariants, then archive the
 * folded anchor's steering. Rejections are per op; nothing is dropped or accepted silently.
 */
export function reconcileFold(
  ledger: Ledger,
  delta: ContinuityDelta,
  foldCtx: FoldContext,
): ReduceResult {
  const work = begin(ledger);
  runOps(work, deltaOps(delta), foldCtx);
  runOps(work, steeringArchiveOps(work.items, foldCtx.anchorName), SYSTEM_CTX);
  return finish(ledger, work);
}

export function markFilePointerStale(ledger: Ledger, id: string): ReduceResult {
  return applyOps(ledger, [{ op: "markStale", id }], SYSTEM_CTX);
}

/**
 * Mark active file pointers stale when `hashOf(path)` differs from the recorded
 * sha256 (a missing file counts as different). Pointers without a hash are unchecked.
 */
export function checkFilePointers(
  ledger: Ledger,
  hashOf: (path: string) => string | undefined,
): ReduceResult {
  const ops: LedgerOp[] = ledger.items
    .filter(
      (item) =>
        item.kind === "file" &&
        item.status === "active" &&
        item.file?.sha256 !== undefined &&
        hashOf(item.file.path) !== item.file.sha256,
    )
    .map((item) => ({ op: "markStale", id: item.id }));
  return applyOps(ledger, ops, SYSTEM_CTX);
}

/**
 * Replace the active ledger with an earlier snapshot (a rewind) without letting the
 * id counter or revision go backwards past what the abandoned ledger already issued.
 */
export function rewindLedger(snapshot: Ledger, abandoned: Ledger): Ledger {
  return {
    version: LEDGER_VERSION,
    rev: Math.max(snapshot.rev, abandoned.rev) + 1,
    nextId: Math.max(snapshot.nextId, abandoned.nextId),
    items: snapshot.items,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Parsing and serialization
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type ParseCode = "invalid_ledger" | "invalid_delta";

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

function readRecord(
  value: unknown,
  path: string,
  code: ParseCode,
  keys: readonly string[],
): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!isRecord(value)) {
    throw new ContinuityError(code, `${path}: expected an object`);
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
    if (!keys.includes(key)) {
      throw new ContinuityError(code, `${path}: unknown field "${key}"`);
    }
  }
  return value;
}

function readString(value: unknown, path: string, code: ParseCode): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length === 0) {
    throw new ContinuityError(code, `${path}: expected a non-empty string`);
  }
  return value;
}

function readStringList(
  value: unknown,
  path: string,
  code: ParseCode,
): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
    throw new ContinuityError(code, `${path}: expected an array`);
  }
  return value.map((entry, i) => readString(entry, `${path}[${i}]`, code));
}

function readOneOf<T extends string>(
  value: unknown,
  allowed: readonly T[],
  path: string,
  code: ParseCode,
): T {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !allowed.includes(value as T)) {
    throw new ContinuityError(
      code,
      `${path}: expected one of ${allowed.join(", ")}`,
    );
  }
  return value as T;
}

function readCount(value: unknown, path: string, min: number): number {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || (value as number) < min) {
    throw new ContinuityError(
      "invalid_ledger",
      `${path}: expected an integer >= ${min}`,
    );
  }
  return value as number;
}

function readFilePointer(
  value: unknown,
  path: string,
  code: ParseCode,
): FilePointer {
  const raw = readRecord(value, path, code, ["path", "lines", "sha256", "why"]);
  const file: FilePointer = {
    path: readString(raw.path, `${path}.path`, code),
    ...(raw.lines !== undefined && {
      lines: readString(raw.lines, `${path}.lines`, code),
    }),
    ...(raw.sha256 !== undefined && {
      sha256: readString(raw.sha256, `${path}.sha256`, code),
    }),
    why: readString(raw.why, `${path}.why`, code),
  };
  if (file.lines !== undefined && !LINES_RE.test(file.lines)) {
    throw new ContinuityError(code, `${path}.lines: expected N or N-M`);
  }
  if (file.sha256 !== undefined && !SHA256_RE.test(file.sha256)) {
    throw new ContinuityError(code, `${path}.sha256: expected 64 hex digits`);
  }
  return file;
}

function parseNewItem(value: unknown, path: string, code: ParseCode): NewItem {
  const raw = readRecord(value, path, code, [
    "kind",
    "text",
    "quote",
    "scopeAnchor",
    "file",
  ]);
  return {
    kind: readOneOf(raw.kind, ITEM_KINDS, `${path}.kind`, code),
    ...(raw.text !== undefined && {
      text: readString(raw.text, `${path}.text`, code),
    }),
    ...(raw.quote !== undefined && {
      quote: readString(raw.quote, `${path}.quote`, code),
    }),
    ...(raw.scopeAnchor !== undefined && {
      scopeAnchor: readString(raw.scopeAnchor, `${path}.scopeAnchor`, code),
    }),
    ...(raw.file !== undefined && {
      file: readFilePointer(raw.file, `${path}.file`, code),
    }),
  };
}

function parseItem(
  value: unknown,
  path: string,
  ledgerRev: number,
  nextId: number,
): LedgerItem {
  const code = "invalid_ledger";
  const fail = (message: string): never => {
    throw new ContinuityError(code, `${path}: ${message}`);
  };
  const raw = readRecord(value, path, code, [
    "id",
    "kind",
    "text",
    "status",
    "source",
    "quote",
    "scopeAnchor",
    "file",
    "supersedes",
    "supersededBy",
    "pinned",
    "createdRev",
    "updatedRev",
  ]);
  const id = readString(raw.id, `${path}.id`, code);
  const kind = readOneOf(raw.kind, ITEM_KINDS, `${path}.kind`, code);

import * as assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { describe, it } from "node:test";

  type FoldRequestOptions,
  type FoldScreenDeps,
  foldRow,
  openFoldScreen,
  parseFocus,
} from "./fold-screen.ts";

const ENTER = "\r";
const ESC = "\x1b";
const UP = "\x1b[A";
const DOWN = "\x1b[B";
const COLUMNS = 60;
const MIN_SAVINGS = 4000;
const MIN_FOCUS = 20;
const FOCUS =
  "Latest instruction: finish the parser fix\nDone since 'impl-start': parser rewritten\nRemaining: add tests";

const anchor = (
  name: string,
  savableTokens: number,
  extra: Partial<AnchorRow> = {},
): AnchorRow => ({
  name,
  percent: 10,
  tokens: 20_000 - savableTokens,
  savableTokens,
  ...extra,
});

/** Root to leaf: `start` frees the most, `recent` too little to be worth a fold. */
const sampleAnchors = (): AnchorRow[] => [
  anchor("start", 42_000, { auto: true }),
  anchor("impl-start", 12_300, { afterPreview: "Implement the parser" }),
  anchor("recent", 900),
];

interface Answers {
  confirms?: boolean[];
  inputs?: (string | undefined)[];
  editors?: (string | undefined)[];
}

type Script = (
  screen: { handleInput(data: string): void },
  lines: string[],
) => void;
const press =
  (...keys: string[]): Script =>
  (screen) => {
    for (const key of keys) screen.handleInput(key);
  };

function harness(
  answers: Answers = {},
  anchors: AnchorRow[] = sampleAnchors(),
) {
  const state = { idle: true, anchors };
  const notifications: { message: string; type?: string }[] = [];
  const dialogs = {
    input: [] as [string, string | undefined][],
    editor: [] as [string, string | undefined][],
    confirm: [] as [string, string][],
  };
  const folds: [string, FoldRequestOptions | undefined][] = [];
  const created: string[] = [];
  const confirms = [...(answers.confirms ?? [])];
  const inputs = [...(answers.inputs ?? [])];
  const editors = [...(answers.editors ?? [])];
  const rendered: string[][] = [];
  const scripts: Script[] = [];
  const theme = {
    fg: (_color: string, text: string) => text,
    bold: (text: string) => text,
    italic: (text: string) => text,
  };
  const ctx = {
    hasUI: true,
    isIdle: () => state.idle,
    ui: {
      notify: (message: string, type?: string) =>
        void notifications.push({ message, type }),
      async confirm(title: string, message: string) {
        dialogs.confirm.push([title, message]);
        return confirms.shift() ?? false;
      },
      async input(title: string, placeholder?: string) {
        dialogs.input.push([title, placeholder]);
        return inputs.shift();
      },
      async editor(title: string, prefill?: string) {
        dialogs.editor.push([title, prefill]);
        return editors.shift();
      },
      custom(
        factory: (...args: unknown[]) => {
          handleInput(data: string): void;
          render(width: number): string[];
        },
      ) {
        const script = scripts.shift();
        assert.ok(script, "unexpected extra screen");
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
          const tui = {
            terminal: { rows: 40, columns: COLUMNS },
            requestRender() {},
          };
          const screen = factory(tui, theme, undefined, resolve);
          const lines = screen.render(COLUMNS);
          rendered.push(lines);
          script(screen, lines);
        });
      },
    },
  } as unknown as ExtensionCommandContext;
  const deps: FoldScreenDeps = {
    listAnchors: () => [...state.anchors],
    setAnchor(_ctx, name) {
      created.push(name);
      state.anchors.push(anchor(name, 0));
      return { ok: true };
    },
    suggestLabel: (_ctx, picked) => `${picked.name}-folded`,
    requestFold: (_ctx, name, opts) => void folds.push([name, opts]),
    minSavingsTokens: MIN_SAVINGS,
    minFocusLength: MIN_FOCUS,
  };
  return {
    ctx,
    deps,
    state,
    notifications,
    dialogs,
    folds,
    created,
    rendered,
    run: (...screens: Script[]) => {
      scripts.push(...screens);
      return openFoldScreen(ctx, deps);
    },
  };
}

import type { AgentMessage } from "@earendil-works/pi-agent-core";
import type { SessionEntry } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";

/** How a completed parent carries its children's reports into model context. */
export type HandoffMode = "full" | "synthesized";

/** Recorded inclusive usage of unique source entries, not new billing. */
export interface HandoffStats {
  readonly messages: number;
  readonly toolCalls: number;
  readonly input: number;
  readonly output: number;
  readonly cacheRead: number;
  readonly cacheWrite: number;
  readonly cost: number;
  readonly usageRecords: number;
}

/** Persisted report metadata; children are references to real summary entry IDs. */
export interface HandoffData {
  readonly version: 1;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly goal: string;
  readonly outcome: string;
  readonly report: string;
  readonly mode: HandoffMode;
  readonly children: readonly string[];
  readonly sourceIds: readonly string[];
  readonly stats: HandoffStats;
}

/** A chronological containment node, distinct from conversation ancestry. */
export interface HistoryGroup {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly entryId: string;
  readonly startId: string;
  readonly state: "folded" | "open";
  readonly sourceIds: readonly string[];
  readonly children: readonly HistoryGroup[];
}

/** Persisted outline of one converted session. Navigation always uses real entry IDs. */
export interface HistoryManifest {
  readonly version: 1;
  readonly sourceOrder: readonly string[];
  readonly groups: readonly HistoryGroup[];
}

const LEGACY_PREAMBLE =
  "The user explored a different conversation branch before returning here.\nSummary of that exploration:\n\n";

/** Remove the old alternative-branch claim without changing the report body. */
export function stripHandoffPreamble(text: string): string {
  return text.startsWith(LEGACY_PREAMBLE)
    ? text.slice(LEGACY_PREAMBLE.length)
    : text;
}

/** Sum each source entry once, including nested-tool and compaction usage. */
export function handoffStats(entries: readonly SessionEntry[]): HandoffStats {
  const result = {
    messages: 0,
    toolCalls: 0,
    input: 0,
    output: 0,
    cacheRead: 0,
    cacheWrite: 0,
    cost: 0,
    usageRecords: 0,
  };
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (seen.has(entry.id)) continue;
    seen.add(entry.id);
    if (entry.type === "message") {
      result.messages++;
      if (entry.message.role === "assistant")
        result.toolCalls += entry.message.content.filter(
          (block) => block.type === "toolCall",
        ).length;
    }
    const usage =
      entry.type === "message" &&
      (entry.message.role === "assistant" ||
        entry.message.role === "toolResult")
        ? entry.message.usage
        : entry.type === "usage" ||
            entry.type === "compaction" ||
            entry.type === "branch_summary"
          ? entry.usage
          : undefined;
    if (!usage) continue;
    result.usageRecords++;
    result.input += usage.input ?? 0;
    result.output += usage.output ?? 0;
    result.cacheRead += usage.cacheRead ?? 0;
    result.cacheWrite += usage.cacheWrite ?? 0;
    result.cost += usage.cost?.total ?? 0;
  }
  return result;
}

function section(report: string, headings: readonly string[]): string {
  const lines = report.split("\n");
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const heading = lines[i]
      .replace(/^#+\s*/, "")
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
    if (!headings.includes(heading)) continue;
    const body: string[] = [];
    for (let j = i + 1; j < lines.length && !/^#+\s/.test(lines[j]); j++)
      body.push(lines[j]);
    const text = body
      .join(" ")
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .replace(/^\s*-\s*(?:\[x\]\s*)?/, "")
      .trim();
    if (text) return text;
  }
  for (const heading of headings) {
    const line = lines.find((line) =>
      line.toLowerCase().startsWith(`- **${heading}:**`),
    );
    if (line) return line.slice(line.indexOf("**", 4) + 2).trim();
  }
  return "Not recorded separately; see the full handoff.";
}

/** Build display and accounting metadata from a reviewed report. */
export function makeHandoff(options: {
  name: string;
  title?: string;
  goal?: string;
  outcome?: string;
  report: string;
  mode: HandoffMode;
  children: readonly string[];
  sourceEntries: readonly SessionEntry[];
}): HandoffData {
  const report = stripHandoffPreamble(options.report);
  return {
    version: 1,
    name: options.name,
    title: options.title ?? options.name.replaceAll("-", " "),
    goal: options.goal ?? section(report, ["goal", "goal/scope"]),
    outcome:
      options.outcome ??
      section(report, [
        "outcome",
        "done",
        "delivered",
        "decisions and outcome",
        "decisions and delivered state",
        "delivered and final state",
        "done/delivered",
      ]),
    report,
    mode: options.mode,
    children: [...options.children],
    sourceIds: [...new Set(options.sourceEntries.map((entry) => entry.id))],
    stats: handoffStats(options.sourceEntries),
  };
}

/** Materialize a frozen context policy; each child is inserted once in supplied chronological order. */
export function materializeHandoff(
  data: HandoffData,
  children: readonly { id: string; summary: string }[],
): string {
  const own = `# Work handoff: ${data.title}\n\n${data.report}`;
  if (data.mode === "synthesized" || !children.length) return own;
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const reports = children
    .filter((child) => !seen.has(child.id) && Boolean(seen.add(child.id)))
    .map((child) => stripHandoffPreamble(child.summary));
  return `${own}\n\n---\n\n## Child handoffs in chronological order\n\nThese are historical reports at each child's completion. The parent report above records the later outcome and superseding decisions.\n\n${reports.join("\n\n---\n\n")}`;
}

function record(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function validHandoff(value: unknown): value is HandoffData {
  if (
    !record(value) ||
    value.version !== 1 ||
    (value.mode !== "full" && value.mode !== "synthesized")
  )
    return false;
  for (const key of ["name", "title", "goal", "outcome", "report"])
    if (typeof value[key] !== "string") return false;
  if (
    !Array.isArray(value.children) ||
    !value.children.every((id) => typeof id === "string") ||
    !Array.isArray(value.sourceIds) ||
    !value.sourceIds.every((id) => typeof id === "string") ||
    !record(value.stats)
  )
    return false;
  for (const key of [
    "messages",
    "toolCalls",
    "input",
    "output",
    "cacheRead",
    "cacheWrite",
    "cost",
    "usageRecords",
  ])
    if (
      typeof value.stats[key] !== "number" ||
      !Number.isFinite(value.stats[key])
    )
      return false;
  return true;
}

/** Read extension-owned metadata; unknown or malformed versions are left to native rendering. */
export function getHandoff(entry: SessionEntry): HandoffData | undefined {
  if (entry.type !== "branch_summary" || !record(entry.details))
    return undefined;
  return validHandoff(entry.details.treeNavigator)
    ? entry.details.treeNavigator
    : undefined;
}

/** Change only projected navigator handoffs, preserving omissions and message ordering. */
export function handoffContext(
  entry: SessionEntry | null,
  messages: AgentMessage[],
  legacyNavigatorOwned = false,
): AgentMessage[] {
  if (!entry || (!getHandoff(entry) && !legacyNavigatorOwned)) return messages;
  return messages.map((message) =>
    message.role === "branchSummary"
      ? {
          role: "custom" as const,
          customType: "navigate-tree-handoff",
          content: stripHandoffPreamble(message.summary),
          display: false,
          timestamp: message.timestamp,
        }
      : message,
  );
}

  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return;
  const m = value as HistoryManifest;
  const ids = new Map(entries.map((e) => [e.id, e]));
  if (
    m.version !== 1 ||
    !Array.isArray(m.sourceOrder) ||
    !m.sourceOrder.length ||
    new Set(m.sourceOrder).size !== m.sourceOrder.length ||
    !m.sourceOrder.every((id) => typeof id === "string" && ids.has(id)) ||
    !Array.isArray(m.groups)
  )
    return;
  const sourceIds = new Set(m.sourceOrder);
  const names = new Set<string>();
  const markers = new Set<string>();
  const validate = (
    groups: readonly HistoryGroup[],
    allowed: readonly string[],
  ): boolean => {
    const positionsById = new Map(allowed.map((id, i) => [id, i]));
    const occupied = new Set<string>();
    let previous = -1;
    return groups.every((g) => {
      if (
        !g ||
        typeof g.name !== "string" ||
        !g.name ||
        names.has(g.name) ||
        typeof g.title !== "string" ||
        !["folded", "open"].includes(g.state) ||
        !Array.isArray(g.sourceIds) ||
        !g.sourceIds.length ||
        !Array.isArray(g.children)
      )
        return false;
      const start = ids.get(g.startId);
      const target = ids.get(g.entryId);
      if (
        start?.type !== "custom" ||
        start.customType !== "tree-phase" ||
        !target ||
        (g.state === "folded"
          ? target.type !== "branch_summary"
          : g.entryId !== g.startId) ||
        sourceIds.has(g.entryId) ||
        markers.has(g.entryId)
      )
        return false;
      const positions = g.sourceIds.map((id) => positionsById.get(id) ?? -1);
      if (
        positions[0] <= previous ||
        positions.some(
          (p, i) => p < 0 || (i > 0 && p !== positions[i - 1] + 1),
        ) ||
        g.sourceIds.some((id) => occupied.has(id))
      )
        return false;
      previous = positions[positions.length - 1];
      for (const id of g.sourceIds) occupied.add(id);
      names.add(g.name);
      markers.add(g.entryId);
      return validate(g.children, g.sourceIds);
    });
  };
  if (validate(m.groups, m.sourceOrder)) return m;
}

function entryText(e: SessionEntry): string {
  if (e.type === "message" && "content" in e.message) {
    const content = e.message.content;
    const text =
      typeof content === "string"
        ? content
        : content.map((b) => ("text" in b ? b.text : b.type)).join(" ");
    return `${e.message.role}: ${text}`.replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  }
  return `${e.type} ${e.id}`;
}

/** Build chronological containment without changing persisted conversation ancestry. */
export function buildHistoryOutline(
  entries: readonly SessionEntry[],
  leaf: string | null,
  expanded?: Set<string>,
  query = "",
): Outline | undefined {
  const manifest = manifestFrom(entries);
  if (!manifest) return;
  const byId = new Map(entries.map((e) => [e.id, e]));
  const ancestry = new Set<string>();
  let cursor = leaf;
  while (cursor && !ancestry.has(cursor)) {
    ancestry.add(cursor);
    cursor = byId.get(cursor)?.parentId ?? null;
  }
  let currentGroup: HistoryGroup | undefined;
  let currentDepth = -1;
  const locate = (groups: readonly HistoryGroup[], depth = 0) => {
    for (const g of groups) {
      if (
        g.state === "open" &&
        (ancestry.has(g.startId) || g.sourceIds.includes(leaf ?? "")) &&
        depth > currentDepth
      ) {
        currentGroup = g;
        currentDepth = depth;
      }
      locate(g.children, depth + 1);
    }
  };
  locate(manifest.groups);
  const open = expanded ?? new Set<string>();
  const all: Row[] = [];
  const emit = (
    order: readonly string[],
    groups: readonly HistoryGroup[],
    parents: string[],
  ) => {
    const starts = new Map(groups.map((g) => [g.sourceIds[0], g]));
    for (let i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
      const id = order[i];
      const g = starts.get(id);
      if (g) {
        all.push({
          id: g.entryId,
          text: `${g.title} (${g.state})`,
          depth: parents.length,
          group: g,
          current: g === currentGroup,
          parents,
        });
        if (!expanded && g.state === "open") {
          open.add(g.entryId);
          for (const p of parents) open.add(p);
        }
        emit(g.sourceIds, g.children, [...parents, g.entryId]);
        i += g.sourceIds.length - 1;
      } else {
        const e = byId.get(id);
        if (
          e &&
          (e.type === "custom_message" ||
            e.type === "branch_summary" ||
            e.type === "compaction" ||
            (e.type === "message" &&
              e.message.role !== "system" &&
              !(
                e.message.role === "assistant" &&
                e.message.content.every((block) => block.type === "toolCall")
              )))
        )
          all.push({
            id,
            text: entryText(e),
            depth: parents.length,
            current: id === leaf,
            parents,
          });
      }
    }
  };
  emit(manifest.sourceOrder, manifest.groups, []);
  const provenanceIndex = entries.findLastIndex(
    (e) => e.type === "custom" && e.customType === "tree-clone-provenance",
  );
  const source = new Set(manifest.sourceOrder);
  for (const e of entries.slice(provenanceIndex + 1)) {
    if (
      !source.has(e.id) &&
      ancestry.has(e.id) &&
      e.type === "message" &&
      e.message.role !== "system"
    ) {
      const parents = currentGroup
        ? [
            ...(all.find((r) => r.group === currentGroup)?.parents ?? []),
            currentGroup.entryId,
          ]
        : [];
      all.push({
        id: e.id,
        text: entryText(e),
        depth: parents.length,
        current: e.id === leaf,
        parents,
      });
    }
  }
  const tokens = query.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const matches = all.filter((r) =>
    tokens.every((t) => r.text.toLowerCase().includes(t)),
  );
  const matchedIds = new Set(matches.map((r) => r.id));
  const revealed = new Set(matches.flatMap((r) => r.parents));
  return {
    expanded: open,
    rows: all.filter((r) =>
      tokens.length
        ? matchedIds.has(r.id) || revealed.has(r.id)
        : r.parents.every((p) => open.has(p)),
    ),
  };
}

/** Install the authorized native /tree outline for manifest-bearing UI sessions only. */
export function registerHistoryOutline(pi: ExtensionAPI): void {
  let context: ExtensionContext | undefined;
  let restore: (() => void) | undefined;
  const states = new WeakMap<object, State>();
  pi.on("session_start", async (_event, ctx) => {
    context = ctx.hasUI && ctx.mode === "tui" ? ctx : undefined;
    if (restore || !context) return;
    try {
      const proto = TreeSelectorComponent?.prototype as unknown as
        | Selector
        | undefined;
      if (
        !proto ||
        typeof proto.render !== "function" ||
        typeof proto.handleInput !== "function" ||
        typeof proto.getTreeList !== "function"
      )
        return;
      previousInstallation?.();
      const render = proto.render;
      const input = proto.handleInput;
      const stateFor = (selector: Selector) => {
        const manager = context?.sessionManager;
        if (!manager) return;
        const list = selector.getTreeList();
        if (
          !list ||
          typeof list.onSelect !== "function" ||
          typeof list.onCancel !== "function" ||
          !Number.isFinite(list.maxVisibleLines)
        )
          return;
        const entries = manager.getEntries();
        const manifest = manifestFrom(entries);
        if (!manifest) return;
        let state = states.get(selector);
        if (
          !state ||
          state.session !== manager ||
          state.manifest !== manifest
        ) {
          const outline = buildHistoryOutline(entries, manager.getLeafId());
          if (!outline) return;
          state = {
            session: manager,
            manifest,
            expanded: outline.expanded,
            selected: Math.max(
              0,
              outline.rows.findIndex((r) => r.current),
            ),
            query: "",
            searching: false,
            raw: false,
          };
          states.set(selector, state);
        }
        const outline = buildHistoryOutline(
          entries,
          manager.getLeafId(),
          state.expanded,
          state.query,
        );
        if (!outline) return;
        state.selected = Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(state.selected, outline.rows.length - 1),
        );
        return {
          state,
          rows: outline.rows,
          list,
          theme: context?.ui.theme as Theme,
        };
      };
      const patchedRender = function (this: Selector, width: number): string[] {
        const view = stateFor(this);
        if (!view || view.state.raw) return render.call(this, width);
        const { state, rows, list, theme } = view;
        const height = Math.max(
          1,
          Math.min(list.maxVisibleLines, (process.stdout.rows || 40) - 9),
        );
        const offset = Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(
            state.selected - Math.floor(height / 2),
            rows.length - height,
          ),
        );
        const lines = [
          theme.fg("borderAccent", "─".repeat(Math.max(0, width))),
          theme.bold("  History · chronological containment"),
          theme.fg(
            "muted",
            state.searching || state.query
              ? `  / ${state.query}`
              : "  Groups contain history; resume starts AFTER handoff",
          ),
        ];
        for (let i = 0; i < height; i++) {
          const row = rows[offset + i];
          lines.push(
            row
              ? theme.fg(
                  offset + i === state.selected ? "accent" : "text",
                  `${offset + i === state.selected ? "❯ " : "  "}${"  ".repeat(Math.min(row.depth, 12))}${row.group ? (state.expanded.has(row.id) || state.query ? "▾ " : "▸ ") : ""}${row.current ? "[current] " : ""}${row.text}`,
                )
              : "",
          );
        }
        lines.push(
          theme.fg(
            "muted",
            `  ${offset + 1}-${Math.min(rows.length, offset + height)} / ${rows.length} · F2 raw tree: native labels / filters`,
          ),
        );
        lines.push(
          `  ${keyText("tui.select.up")}/${keyText("tui.select.down")} move · ${keyHint("tui.select.confirm", "toggle / resume")} · Space toggle`,
        );
        lines.push(
          `  r resume AFTER handoff · / search · ${keyHint("tui.select.cancel", "clear / close")} · F2 raw`,
        );
        lines.push(theme.fg("borderAccent", "─".repeat(Math.max(0, width))));
        return lines.map((line) => truncateToWidth(line, Math.max(0, width)));
      };
      const patchedInput = function (this: Selector, data: string): void {
        const view = stateFor(this);
        if (!view) {
          input.call(this, data);
          return;
        }
        const { state, rows, list } = view;
        const kb = getKeybindings();
        if (matchesKey(data, "f2")) {
          state.raw = !state.raw;
          return;
        }
        if (state.raw) {
          input.call(this, data);
          return;
        }
        if (kb.matches(data, "tui.select.cancel")) {
          if (state.searching || state.query) {
            state.searching = false;
            state.query = "";
          } else list.onCancel();
          return;
        }
        if (kb.matches(data, "tui.select.up")) {
          state.selected = Math.max(0, state.selected - 1);
          return;
        }
        if (kb.matches(data, "tui.select.down")) {
          state.selected = Math.min(rows.length - 1, state.selected + 1);
          return;
        }
        if (state.searching) {
          if (kb.matches(data, "tui.select.confirm")) state.searching = false;
          else if (matchesKey(data, "backspace"))
            state.query = [...state.query].slice(0, -1).join("");
          else if (
            [...data].every(
              (c) => c.charCodeAt(0) >= 32 && c.charCodeAt(0) !== 127,
            )
          )
            state.query += data;
          state.selected = 0;
          return;
        }
        if (data === "/") {
          state.searching = true;
          return;
        }
        const row = rows[state.selected];
        if (!row) return;
        if (data === "r" && row.group) {
          list.onSelect(row.id);
          return;
        }
        if (kb.matches(data, "tui.select.confirm") || data === " ") {
          if (row.group) {
            if (state.expanded.has(row.id)) state.expanded.delete(row.id);
            else state.expanded.add(row.id);
          } else if (kb.matches(data, "tui.select.confirm"))
            list.onSelect(row.id);
        }
      };
      proto.render = patchedRender;
      proto.handleInput = patchedInput;
      restore = () => {
        if (proto.render === patchedRender) proto.render = render;
        if (proto.handleInput === patchedInput) proto.handleInput = input;
      };
      previousInstallation = restore;
    } catch {
      /* Unsupported host internals leave the native tree intact. */
    }
  });
  pi.on("session_shutdown", async () => {
    context = undefined;
    restore?.();
    restore = undefined;
  });
}

  it("returns null when no text is found within MAX_HINT_WALK_DEPTH", () => {
    // Build a chain whose head is a custom_message with no text content,
    // followed by user-text entries beyond the walker's reach \u2014 the
    // walker should give up at depth MAX_HINT_WALK_DEPTH and never
    // reach the texts.
    const sm = SessionManager.inMemory("/tmp");
    // First push the deep texts (positioned beyond the walker's reach).
    for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
      sm.appendMessage({
        role: "user",
        content: [{ type: "text", text: `deep ${i}` }],
      } as never);
    }
    // Now push thinking-only assistant messages on top so the walk
    // bottoms out before reaching the user texts. We need at least
    // MAX_HINT_WALK_DEPTH thinking entries; use +10 for safety margin.
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_HINT_WALK_DEPTH + 10; i++) {
      sm.appendMessage({
        role: "assistant",
        content: [{ type: "thinking", thinking: "..." }],
        api: "anthropic",
        provider: "claude",
        model: "claude-sonnet-4-5",
        stopReason: "endTurn",
