export function renderFoldCaptureSection(
  ledger: Ledger,
  anchorName: string,
  userEntries: readonly UserEntryRef[] = [],
): string {
  const active = ledger.items.filter((item) => item.status === "active");
  const section = (title: string, items: readonly LedgerItem[]): string[] =>
    items.length === 0
      ? []
      : ["", `${title}:`, ...[...items].sort(byId).map(renderItem)];
  const inSpan = (item: LedgerItem): boolean =>
    item.scopeAnchor === undefined || item.scopeAnchor === anchorName;
  return [
    ...(active.length > 0
      ? [
          `Continuity ledger rev ${ledger.rev}. These items stay in force across this fold and are carried outside your prose summary; do not restate them.`,
        ]
      : []),
    ...section(
      "Binding rules",
      active.filter((item) => item.kind === "rule"),
    ),
    ...section(
      "Decisions",
      active.filter((item) => item.kind === "decision"),
    ),
    ...section(
      "Open goals",
      active.filter((item) => item.kind === "sub-goal" && inSpan(item)),
    ),
    ...section(
      `Steering scoped to ${anchorName} (archived by this fold)`,
      active.filter(
        (item) => item.kind === "steering" && item.scopeAnchor === anchorName,
      ),
    ),
    ...(userEntries.length > 0
      ? [
          "",
          "User messages in the folded span (cite an id as citedEntryId when one of them changed an earlier rule or decision):",
          ...userEntries
            .slice(-MAX_USER_ENTRY_REFS)
            .map(
              (ref) =>
                `- ${ref.id}: ${capText(ref.preview, USER_REF_PREVIEW_CHARS)}`,
            ),
        ]
      : []),
    "",
    `After the summary, append at most one continuity-delta block: JSON between the tags shown below, empty keys omitted.`,
    "- completed: ids of goals finished in the folded span.",
    "- ratified: new durable rules, decisions or facts. Give quote as the user's exact words where they exist; scopeAnchor only for steering and goals.",
    "- superseded: only when the user later changed their mind; citedEntryId must name that user message.",
    "- expiredSteering: ids of steering no longer relevant.",
    "User rules, decisions and the objective cannot be removed, rewritten or completed this way; such entries are rejected and reported.",
    DELTA_SCHEMA,
  ].join("\n");
}

const FENCE_RE = /^```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```$/;

function count(text: string, needle: string): number {
  return text.split(needle).length - 1;
}

/**
 * Extract and strictly validate the `<continuity-delta>` block from model output.
 * Returns undefined when the text has no block; throws `ContinuityError`
 * (`invalid_delta`) for a malformed, duplicated or unclosed one.
 */
export function parseContinuityDelta(
  text: string,
): ContinuityDelta | undefined {
  const opens = count(text, DELTA_OPEN);
  const closes = count(text, DELTA_CLOSE);
  if (opens === 0 && closes === 0) return undefined;
  const start = text.indexOf(DELTA_OPEN) + DELTA_OPEN.length;
  const end = text.indexOf(DELTA_CLOSE);
  if (opens !== 1 || closes !== 1 || end < start) {
    throw new ContinuityError(
      "invalid_delta",
      `expected exactly one ${DELTA_OPEN}...${DELTA_CLOSE} block`,
    );
  }
  const body = text.slice(start, end).trim();
  let json: unknown;
  try {
    json = JSON.parse(FENCE_RE.exec(body)?.[1] ?? body);
  } catch (error) {
    throw new ContinuityError(
      "invalid_delta",
      `${CONTINUITY_DELTA_TAG} is not valid JSON: ${(error as Error).message}`,
    );
  }
  return parseDelta(json);
}

export interface ExtractedDelta {
  /** The model's reply with a complete delta block removed. */
  readonly text: string;
  readonly delta?: ContinuityDelta;
  /** Set when a complete block was present but unusable; nothing was applied. */
  readonly error?: ContinuityError;
}

/**
 * Non-throwing variant for the fold path: a stray tag in prose is ignored, a
 * single complete block is parsed and stripped from the text, and anything
 * unusable is reported in `error` so a fold never fails because of it.
 */
export function extractContinuityDelta(text: string): ExtractedDelta {
  const start = text.indexOf(DELTA_OPEN);
  const end =
    start < 0 ? -1 : text.indexOf(DELTA_CLOSE, start + DELTA_OPEN.length);
  if (start < 0 || end < 0) return { text };
  const stripped =
    `${text.slice(0, start)}${text.slice(end + DELTA_CLOSE.length)}`
      .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
      .trimEnd();
  if (count(text, DELTA_OPEN) !== 1 || count(text, DELTA_CLOSE) !== 1) {
    return {
      text,
      error: new ContinuityError(
        "invalid_delta",
        `expected exactly one ${DELTA_OPEN}...${DELTA_CLOSE} block`,
      ),
    };
  }
  try {
    const delta = parseContinuityDelta(text);
    return delta ? { text: stripped, delta } : { text };
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof ContinuityError)) throw error;
    return { text: stripped, error };
  }
}

export interface LedgerUiSummary {
  readonly goals: number;
  readonly tasks: number;
  readonly rules: number;
  readonly decisions: number;
  readonly steering: number;
  readonly facts: number;
  readonly files: number;
  readonly staleFiles: number;
  readonly rev: number;
  /** e.g. `1 goal · 4 rules · 2 tasks · rev 14`; zero counts are omitted. */
  readonly line: string;
}

/** Counts of active items (tasks are active sub-goals; goals are the objective) for the /anchor hub badge. */
export function summarizeLedgerForUi(ledger: Ledger): LedgerUiSummary {
  const countOf = (kind: ItemKind, status: LedgerItem["status"] = "active") =>
    ledger.items.filter((i) => i.kind === kind && i.status === status).length;
  const counts = {
    goals: countOf("objective"),
    tasks: countOf("sub-goal"),
    rules: countOf("rule"),
    decisions: countOf("decision"),
    steering: countOf("steering"),
    facts: countOf("fact"),
    files: countOf("file"),
    staleFiles: countOf("file", "stale"),
  };
  const parts = [
    counts.goals > 0 && plural(counts.goals, "goal"),
    counts.rules > 0 && plural(counts.rules, "rule"),
    counts.tasks > 0 && plural(counts.tasks, "task"),
    counts.decisions > 0 && plural(counts.decisions, "decision"),
    counts.steering > 0 && `${counts.steering} steering`,
    counts.staleFiles > 0 && `${counts.staleFiles} stale`,
  ].filter((part): part is string => typeof part === "string");
  if (parts.length === 0) parts.push("empty");
  parts.push(`rev ${ledger.rev}`);
  return { ...counts, rev: ledger.rev, line: parts.join(" · ") };
}

/**
 * Capture side of the Session Continuity Ledger: turns user messages and
 * `ask_user` answers on the active branch into ledger ops.
 *
 * Capture is deterministic first. `ask_user` answers need no model, and user
 * messages go through an `IntentClassifier` that only decides what a message
 * is: the stored text is always the user's verbatim words, never a rewrite.
 * Ops are returned, not applied; the ledger enforces every invariant.
 *
 * No I/O. Pi runtime imports are type-only.
 */

import type {
  ClassifierContext,
  ClassifierResult,
} from "@earendil-works/pi-ai";
import type {
  ModelRegistry,
  SessionEntry,
} from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
import {
  capText,
  type Ledger,
  type LedgerItem,
  type LedgerOp,
  MAX_ITEM_TEXT_CHARS,
  MAX_QUOTE_CHARS,
  type NewItem,
  normalizeText,
  type OpContext,
  TRUNCATION_MARKER,
} from "./continuity-ledger.ts";
import { extractTextContent, isValidName, LABEL_PREFIX } from "./helpers.ts";

export const INTENT_KINDS = [
  "objective",
  "sub-goal",
  "rule",
  "decision",
  "steering",
  "ephemeral",
] as const;

export type IntentKind = (typeof INTENT_KINDS)[number];

export interface IntentInput {
  entryId: string;
  text: string;
  /** Anchor the message falls under (latest `anchor:` label before it), if any. */
  activeAnchor?: string;
  activeItems: readonly { id: string; kind: string; text: string }[];
}

/** One sentence of a message that states a rule or decision on its own. */
export interface IntentExcerpt {
  kind: "rule" | "decision";
  /** The sentence, verbatim as the user wrote it. */
  text: string;
}

export interface IntentVerdict {
  kind: IntentKind;
  /** Ids of active ledger items the message replaces or reverses. */
  supersedes?: readonly string[];
  /** Sentences captured on their own, for a message too long to judge as a whole. */
  excerpts?: readonly IntentExcerpt[];

}

export type IntentClassifier = (
  input: IntentInput,
  signal?: AbortSignal,

export interface CapturedOp {

  classified: number;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Heuristic classifier
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Explicit durable-rule wording. `must always` and `must never` are covered by
// the bare words. False positives become protected ledger items, so the lists
// stay short and literal.
export const RULE_MARKERS: readonly RegExp[] = [
  /\balways\b/i,
  /\bnever\b/i,
  /\bfrom now on\b/i,
  /\bgoing forward\b/i,
  /\bdon'?t ever\b/i,
  /\bdo not ever\b/i,
  /\bremember:/i,
  /\brule:/i,
  /\bprefer\b/i,
];

export const DECISION_MARKERS: readonly RegExp[] = [
  /\blet'?s go with\b/i,
  /\bwe decided\b/i,
  /\bdecision:/i,
  /\bgo with option\b/i,
];

export const OBJECTIVE_MARKERS: readonly RegExp[] = [
  /\bgoal:/i,
  /\bobjective:/i,
  /\bthe goal is\b/i,
];

// "never mind" is dismissal, not a rule.
const NON_MARKER_PHRASES = /\bnever ?mind\b/gi;

// Longer messages are pasted content or mixed requests, and the ledger would
// keep only a truncated quote of them. Only a model classifier judges those as
// a whole; the heuristic only lifts out sentences that carry a marker.
const HEURISTIC_MAX_CHARS = MAX_QUOTE_CHARS;
const MIN_MESSAGE_CHARS = 12;
const MAX_EXCERPTS = 3;
const SENTENCE_BREAK = /(?<=[.!?\u3002\uff01\uff1f])\s+/;
const CODE_FENCE_RE = /^\s*(```|~~~)/;
// Blockquotes and indented code are other people's words or pasted source.
const QUOTED_LINE_RE = /^(\s*>| {4}|\t)/;

const matchesAny = (markers: readonly RegExp[], text: string): boolean =>
  markers.some((marker) => marker.test(text));

function heuristicKind(rawText: string): IntentKind {
  const text = rawText
    .trim()
    .replace(/[\u2018\u2019]/g, "'")
    .replace(NON_MARKER_PHRASES, " ");
  if (text.length === 0 || text.length > HEURISTIC_MAX_CHARS) {
    return "ephemeral";
  }
  if (/[?？]$/.test(text)) return "ephemeral";
  if (matchesAny(OBJECTIVE_MARKERS, text)) return "objective";
  if (matchesAny(DECISION_MARKERS, text)) return "decision";
  if (matchesAny(RULE_MARKERS, text)) return "rule";
  return "ephemeral";
}

function proseSentences(text: string): string[] {
  const sentences: string[] = [];
  let fenced = false;
  for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (CODE_FENCE_RE.test(line)) {
      fenced = !fenced;
    } else if (!fenced && !QUOTED_LINE_RE.test(line)) {
      sentences.push(...line.split(SENTENCE_BREAK).map((s) => s.trim()));
    }
  }
  return sentences;
}

// Bare "always", "never" and "prefer" are everyday words in pasted logs, docs
// and specs; inside a long message only explicit durable-rule wording counts.
const BARE_RULE_MARKERS: readonly RegExp[] = [
  /\balways\b/i,
  /\bnever\b/i,
  /\bprefer\b/i,
];
const EXPLICIT_RULE_MARKERS = RULE_MARKERS.filter(
  (marker) => !BARE_RULE_MARKERS.some((bare) => bare.source === marker.source),
);

// The short-message marker rules applied sentence by sentence; a rule sentence
// needs explicit wording.
function heuristicExcerpts(text: string): IntentExcerpt[] {
  const excerpts: IntentExcerpt[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const sentence of proseSentences(text)) {
    if (
      sentence.length < MIN_MESSAGE_CHARS ||
      sentence.length > HEURISTIC_MAX_CHARS
    ) {
      continue;
    }
    const kind = heuristicKind(sentence);
    if (kind !== "rule" && kind !== "decision") continue;
    if (
      kind === "rule" &&
      !matchesAny(
        EXPLICIT_RULE_MARKERS,
        sentence
          .replace(/[\u2018\u2019]/g, "'")
          .replace(NON_MARKER_PHRASES, " "),
      )
    ) {
      continue;
    }
    if (seen.has(normalizeText(sentence))) continue;
    seen.add(normalizeText(sentence));
    excerpts.push({ kind, text: sentence });
    if (excerpts.length === MAX_EXCERPTS) break;
  }
  return excerpts;
}

/**
 * Marker-based classifier: no I/O, never supersedes, misses anything phrased
 * without an explicit marker ("drop X and only keep Y" is ephemeral to it).
 * A message over the length limit is ephemeral as a whole, but up to three of
 * its rule or decision sentences come back as `excerpts`.
 */
export const heuristicClassifier: IntentClassifier = async (input) => {
  const kind = heuristicKind(input.text);
  const excerpts =
    kind === "ephemeral" && input.text.trim().length > HEURISTIC_MAX_CHARS
      ? heuristicExcerpts(input.text.trim())
      : [];
  return {
    kind,
    by: "heuristic",
    ...(excerpts.length > 0 && { excerpts }),
  };
};

export const DEFAULT_MIN_CONFIDENCE = 0.7;

export const MAX_CLASSIFIER_MESSAGE_CHARS = 4_000;

  rule: "A standing instruction for all later work: always, never, prefer, conventions",
  decision:

  steering:

    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        (KIND_PRIORITY[a.kind] ?? 3) - (KIND_PRIORITY[b.kind] ?? 3) ||
        idNumber(b.id) - idNumber(a.id),
    )
    .slice(0, MAX_CLASSIFIER_ITEMS);
}

function classifierContext(
  input: IntentInput,
  items: IntentInput["activeItems"],
): ClassifierContext {
  const oneLine = (text: string) =>
    capText(text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(), MAX_CLASSIFIER_ITEM_CHARS);
  return {
    state: {
      message: capText(input.text, MAX_CLASSIFIER_MESSAGE_CHARS),
      activeAnchor: input.activeAnchor ?? null,
      activeItems: items.map(({ id, kind, text }) => ({
        id,
        kind,
        text: oneLine(text),
      })),
    },
    questions: {
      kind: {
        type: "choice",
        instructions:
          "What kind of instruction is the user's message? Judge only the message, not the items.",
        criteria: KIND_CRITERIA,
      },
      ...(items.length > 0 && {
        contradicts: {
          type: "choice" as const,
          instructions:
            "Which active item, if any, does the message explicitly replace, reverse or contradict?",
          criteria: {
            ...Object.fromEntries(items.map((i) => [i.id, oneLine(i.text)])),
            [NO_CONTRADICTION]: "The message changes none of the items",
          },
        },
      }),
    },
  };
}

const ephemeral = (warning?: string): IntentVerdict => ({
  kind: "ephemeral",
  by: "classifier",
  ...(warning !== undefined && { warning }),
});

function verdictFrom(
  result: ClassifierResult,
  items: IntentInput["activeItems"],
  minConfidence: number,
): IntentVerdict {
  const kind = result.answers.kind;
  if (
    kind?.type !== "choice" ||
    kind.confidence < minConfidence ||
    !isIntentKind(kind.choice) ||
    kind.choice === "ephemeral"
  ) {
    return ephemeral();
  }
  const contradicts = result.answers.contradicts;
  const named =
    contradicts?.type === "choice" &&
    contradicts.confidence >= minConfidence &&
    items.some((item) => item.id === contradicts.choice)
      ? contradicts.choice
      : undefined;
  return {
    kind: kind.choice,
    by: "classifier",
    ...(named !== undefined && { supersedes: [named] }),
  };
}

/**
 * Classify with a registry classifier model, one call per message. Resolves to
 * `undefined` (after `opts.onWarning`) when `model` is malformed or unknown;
 * never throws. A low-confidence or malformed answer is ephemeral. After the
 * first provider error the instance stops calling the model, answers with the
 * heuristic classifier so no explicit rule is lost during an outage, and
 * reports the failure once through `IntentVerdict.warning`; create a new
 * instance to retry.
 */
export async function createModelClassifier(
  registry: Pick<ModelRegistry, "getModelOfType" | "classify">,
  model: string,
  opts: { minConfidence?: number; onWarning?: (message: string) => void } = {},
): Promise<IntentClassifier | undefined> {
  const minConfidence = opts.minConfidence ?? DEFAULT_MIN_CONFIDENCE;
  const parsed = parseClassifierModel(model);
  const classifierModel = parsed
    ? registry.getModelOfType("classifier", parsed.provider, parsed.id)
    : undefined;
  if (!classifierModel) {
    opts.onWarning?.(
      `navigate_tree: continuity classifier model ${JSON.stringify(model)} is not a known classifier model (expected "provider/id"); capture uses heuristics only.`,
    );
    return undefined;
  }
  let failed = false;
  return async (input, signal) => {
    if (signal?.aborted) return ephemeral();
    if (failed) return heuristicClassifier(input, signal);
    const items = pickItems(input.activeItems);
    let result: ClassifierResult | undefined;
    let reason: string | undefined;
    try {
      result = await registry.classify(
        classifierModel,
        classifierContext(input, items),
        signal ? { signal } : undefined,
      );
      if (result.stopReason !== "stop") {
        reason = result.errorMessage ?? result.stopReason;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    }
    if (signal?.aborted) return ephemeral();
    if (!result || reason !== undefined) {
      const first = !failed;
      failed = true;
      const fallback = await heuristicClassifier(input, signal);
      return first
        ? {
            ...fallback,
            warning: `navigate_tree: continuity classifier ${model} failed (${reason}); user instructions are captured by heuristics instead.`,
          }
        : fallback;
    }
    return verdictFrom(result, items, minConfidence);
  };
}

// Capture

const CLASSIFY_CONCURRENCY = 4;
// Slash commands that reach the model are expanded text, not user intent; the
// `[navigate_tree` prefix is this extension's own injected user messages.
const SLASH_COMMAND_RE = /^\/[\w:.-]+(\s|$)/;
const OWN_MESSAGE_PREFIX = "[navigate_tree";

/** The user message `/anchor` injects to request a fold: machine-generated, never intent. */
export const FOLD_REQUEST_RE =
  /^Please fold the work since the '[^']*' anchor: call navigate_tree\(action='rewind'/;
const ASK_ANSWER_MAX_CHARS = 300;
const SUPERSEDABLE_KINDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  "objective",
  "sub-goal",
  "rule",
  "decision",
  "steering",
]);

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

const oneLine = (text: string): string => text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

const nonBlank = (value: unknown): string | undefined =>
  typeof value === "string" && value.trim().length > 0
    ? value.trim()
    : undefined;

function scanStart(
  branch: readonly SessionEntry[],
  watermark: string | undefined,
): number {
  if (watermark !== undefined) {
    const at = branch.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === watermark);
    if (at >= 0) return at + 1;
  }
  // Entries before the latest fold were captured into the ledger it carries.
  return branch.findLastIndex((entry) => entry.type === "branch_summary") + 1;
}

/** Anchor name in force at each branch index: the latest `anchor:` label target strictly before it. */
function anchorAt(
  branch: readonly SessionEntry[],
): (index: number) => string | undefined {
  const positions = new Map(branch.map((entry, i) => [entry.id, i] as const));
  const labels = new Map<string, string | undefined>();
  for (const entry of branch) {
    if (entry.type === "label") labels.set(entry.targetId, entry.label);
  }
  const anchors: { index: number; name: string }[] = [];
  for (const [targetId, label] of labels) {
    const index = positions.get(targetId);
    const name = label?.startsWith(LABEL_PREFIX)
      ? label.slice(LABEL_PREFIX.length)
      : undefined;
    if (index !== undefined && isValidName(name)) anchors.push({ index, name });
  }
  anchors.sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
  return (index) => anchors.findLast((anchor) => anchor.index < index)?.name;
}

const ASK_PREFIX = "Q: ";
const ASK_JOINER = " → A: ";

function askQuestionText(question: string, answer: string): string {
  const budget =
    MAX_ITEM_TEXT_CHARS - ASK_PREFIX.length - ASK_JOINER.length - answer.length;
  return `${ASK_PREFIX}${capText(question, budget)}${ASK_JOINER}${answer}`;
}

/** Whether `item` is a captured `ask_user` answer to the question with this full text. */
function isAnswerTo(item: LedgerItem, question: string): boolean {
  if (
    item.kind !== "decision" ||
    item.source.origin !== "ask_user" ||
    !item.text.startsWith(ASK_PREFIX)
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  const stored = item.text.slice(ASK_PREFIX.length);
  if (stored.startsWith(question + ASK_JOINER)) return true;
  // A long question was cut to fit: its stored head is a prefix of the full one.
  const cut = stored.indexOf(TRUNCATION_MARKER + ASK_JOINER);
  return (
    cut >= 0 &&
    question.length > cut &&
    question.startsWith(stored.slice(0, cut))
  );
}

interface AskAnswer {
  entryId: string;
  /** Full question text, one line. */
  question: string;
  text: string;
  quote: string;
}

/** One answer per answered question of a submitted `ask_user` result. */
function askUserAnswers(entry: SessionEntry): AskAnswer[] {
  if (entry.type !== "message" || entry.message.role !== "toolResult") {
    return [];
  }
  const { toolName, isError } = entry.message;
  const details: unknown = entry.message.details;
  if (toolName !== "ask_user" || isError || !isRecord(details)) return [];
  if (
    details.cancelled !== false ||
    details.error !== undefined ||
    details.mode !== "submit" ||
    !Array.isArray(details.questions) ||
    !isRecord(details.answers)
  ) {
    return [];
  }
  const answers: AskAnswer[] = [];
  for (const question of details.questions) {
    if (!isRecord(question) || typeof question.id !== "string") continue;
    const answer = details.answers[question.id];
    if (!isRecord(answer) || !Array.isArray(answer.labels)) continue;
    const labels = answer.labels
      .map(nonBlank)
      .filter((label): label is string => label !== undefined);
    if (labels.length === 0) continue;
    const chosen = labels.join(", ");
    const note = nonBlank(answer.note);
    const answerText = capText(
      oneLine(note ? `${chosen} (note: ${note})` : chosen),
      ASK_ANSWER_MAX_CHARS,
    );
    const prompt = nonBlank(question.prompt) ?? nonBlank(question.label);
    const questionText = oneLine(prompt ?? question.id);
    answers.push({
      entryId: entry.id,
      question: questionText,
      text: askQuestionText(questionText, answerText),
      quote: chosen,
    });
  }
  return answers;
}

interface Candidate {
  entryId: string;
  index: number;
  text: string;
}

function userCandidate(
  entry: SessionEntry,
  index: number,
): Candidate | undefined {
  if (entry.type !== "message" || entry.message.role !== "user") {
    return undefined;
  }
  const text = extractTextContent(entry.message.content).trim();
  if (
    text.length < MIN_MESSAGE_CHARS ||
    SLASH_COMMAND_RE.test(text) ||
    text.startsWith(OWN_MESSAGE_PREFIX) ||
    FOLD_REQUEST_RE.test(text)
  ) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return { entryId: entry.id, index, text };
}

async function mapPool<T, R>(
  items: readonly T[],
  limit: number,
  fn: (item: T) => Promise<R>,
): Promise<R[]> {
  const out = new Array<R>(items.length);
  let next = 0;
  const worker = async () => {
    for (let i = next++; i < items.length; i = next++) {
      out[i] = await fn(items[i] as T);
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, items.length) }, worker),
  );
  return out;
}

/** Ledger state the translation of one scan tracks, since its ops are not applied yet. */
interface ScanState {
  objective: { id?: string; text: string } | undefined;
  superseded: Set<string>;
}

/**
 * A `decision` for an answered question. A later answer to a question that
 * already has an active answer replaces it, citing the new answer's entry; the
 * ledger accepts that as a user-origin self citation.
 */
function askOp(
  answer: AskAnswer,
  active: ReadonlyMap<string, LedgerItem>,
  state: ScanState,
): CapturedOp {
  const item: NewItem = {
    kind: "decision",
    text: answer.text,
    quote: answer.quote,
  };
  const ctx: OpContext = { origin: "ask_user", entryId: answer.entryId };
  const earlier = [...active.values()].filter(
    (old) => !state.superseded.has(old.id) && isAnswerTo(old, answer.question),
  );
  const unchanged = earlier.some(
    (old) => normalizeText(old.text) === normalizeText(answer.text),
  );
  if (earlier.length === 0 || unchanged)
    return { op: { op: "add", ...item }, ctx };
  for (const old of earlier) state.superseded.add(old.id);
  return {
    op: {
      op: "supersede",
      ids: earlier.map((old) => old.id),
      with: item,
      citedEntryId: answer.entryId,
    },
    ctx,
  };
}

function excerptOps(
  verdict: IntentVerdict,
  entryId: string,
  userEntryIndex: OpContext["userEntryIndex"],
): CapturedOp[] {
  return (verdict.excerpts ?? []).map(({ kind, text }) => ({
    op: { op: "add", kind, text, quote: text },
    ctx: { origin: "user", entryId, userEntryIndex },
  }));
}

function userOp(
  verdict: IntentVerdict,
  candidate: Candidate,
  anchor: string | undefined,
  active: ReadonlyMap<string, LedgerItem>,
  state: ScanState,
  userEntryIndex: OpContext["userEntryIndex"],
): CapturedOp | undefined {
  const { kind } = verdict;
  if (kind === "ephemeral" || (kind === "steering" && anchor === undefined)) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const { text, entryId } = candidate;
  let target: Exclude<IntentKind, "ephemeral"> = kind;
  const named = (verdict.supersedes ?? []).filter((id) => {
    const item = active.get(id);
    return item?.kind === kind && !state.superseded.has(id);
  });
  let ids = named;
  if (
    kind === "objective" &&
    state.objective &&
    !named.includes(state.objective.id ?? "")
  ) {
    // Only one objective may be active, and only the classifier may replace it.
    if (normalizeText(state.objective.text) === normalizeText(text)) {
      return undefined;
    }
    target = "sub-goal";
    ids = [];
  }
  for (const id of ids) state.superseded.add(id);
  if (target === "objective") state.objective = { text };
  const item: NewItem = {
    kind: target,
    text,
    quote: text,
    ...(target === "steering" && { scopeAnchor: anchor }),
  };
  return {
    op:
      ids.length > 0
        ? { op: "supersede", ids, with: item, citedEntryId: entryId }
        : { op: "add", ...item },
    ctx: { origin: "user", entryId, userEntryIndex },
  };
}

/**
 * Turn the entries after `watermark` into ledger ops.
 *
 * `branch` is root-to-leaf (`sm.getBranch()`). Scanning starts after the
 * watermark entry, or after the latest `branch_summary` when the watermark is
 * missing or off the branch. Entries that already sourced a ledger item are
 * skipped so a lost watermark cannot resurrect superseded items; anything else
 * re-captured is a ledger `duplicate`. If `opts.signal` aborts, no ops are
 * returned and the watermark does not move.
 */
export async function captureIntent(
  branch: readonly SessionEntry[],
  watermark: string | undefined,
  ledger: Ledger,
  classifier: IntentClassifier,
  opts: { signal?: AbortSignal } = {},
): Promise<CaptureResult> {
  const scanned = branch.slice(scanStart(branch, watermark));
  const warnings = new Set<string>();
  const done = (ops: CapturedOp[], classified: number): CaptureResult => ({
    ops,
    watermark: scanned.length > 0 ? scanned[scanned.length - 1]?.id : watermark,
    classified,
    warnings: [...warnings],
  });
  if (scanned.length === 0) return done([], 0);

  const captured = new Set(
    ledger.items.flatMap((item) =>
      item.source.entryId === undefined ? [] : [item.source.entryId],
    ),
  );
  const offset = branch.length - scanned.length;
  const fresh = scanned.map((entry, i) => ({ entry, index: offset + i }));
  const candidates = fresh.flatMap(({ entry, index }) => {
    const candidate = captured.has(entry.id)
      ? undefined
      : userCandidate(entry, index);
    return candidate ? [candidate] : [];
  });

  const active = new Map(
    ledger.items
      .filter(
        (item) => item.status === "active" && SUPERSEDABLE_KINDS.has(item.kind),
      )
      .map((item) => [item.id, item] as const),
  );
  const activeItems = [...active.values()].map(({ id, kind, text }) => ({
    id,
    kind,
    text,
  }));
  const anchorFor = anchorAt(branch);
  const verdicts = await mapPool(
    candidates,
    CLASSIFY_CONCURRENCY,
    async (c) => {
      if (opts.signal?.aborted) return undefined;
      const anchor = anchorFor(c.index);
      try {
        return await classifier(
          {
            entryId: c.entryId,
            text: c.text,
            ...(anchor !== undefined && { activeAnchor: anchor }),
            activeItems,
          },
          opts.signal,
        );
      } catch (error) {
        if (opts.signal?.aborted) return undefined;
        warnings.add(
          `navigate_tree: continuity intent classifier failed (${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}); the message was not captured.`,
        );
        return undefined;
      }
    },
  );
  if (opts.signal?.aborted) return { ...done([], 0), watermark };

  for (const verdict of verdicts) {
    if (verdict?.warning !== undefined) warnings.add(verdict.warning);
  }
  const classified = new Map(
    candidates.map((c, i) => [
      c.entryId,
      { candidate: c, verdict: verdicts[i] },
    ]),
  );
  const userEntries = new Map(
    branch.flatMap((entry, i) =>
      entry.type === "message" && entry.message.role === "user"
        ? [[entry.id, i] as const]
        : [],
    ),
  );
  const userEntryIndex = (id: string) => userEntries.get(id);
  const state: ScanState = {
    objective: ledger.items
      .filter((item) => item.kind === "objective" && item.status === "active")
      .map((item) => ({ id: item.id, text: item.text }))[0],
    superseded: new Set(),
  };

  // Answers to one question are judged across the whole scan, including entries
  // already captured, so only the newest one is emitted and a lost watermark
  // cannot bring back an answer a later one replaced.
  const answers = new Map(
    fresh.map(({ entry }) => [entry.id, askUserAnswers(entry)] as const),
  );
  const newest = new Map<string, AskAnswer>();
  for (const list of answers.values()) {
    for (const answer of list) newest.set(answer.question, answer);
  }

  const ops: CapturedOp[] = [];
  for (const { entry, index } of fresh) {
    if (captured.has(entry.id)) continue;
    for (const answer of answers.get(entry.id) ?? []) {
      if (newest.get(answer.question) === answer) {
        ops.push(askOp(answer, active, state));
      }
    }
    const hit = classified.get(entry.id);
    if (!hit?.verdict) continue;
    ops.push(...excerptOps(hit.verdict, entry.id, userEntryIndex));
    const op = userOp(
      hit.verdict,
      hit.candidate,
      anchorFor(index),
      active,
      state,
      userEntryIndex,
    );
    if (op) ops.push(op);
  }
  return done(ops, candidates.length);
}

/**
 * Branch-local persistence of the Session Continuity Ledger.
 *
 * Between folds the ledger is the replay of `navigate-tree-continuity-ops`
 * custom entries on the active branch (never sent to the model). A fold stores
 * the reconciled snapshot on `branch_summary.details[LEDGER_DETAILS_KEY]`; the
 * snapshot already includes everything from the abandoned span, so on replay it
 * replaces the running ledger. Ops entries on an abandoned branch are not on
 * the active one, which is why the snapshot is the carrier.
 *
 * Pure functions over session entries, except `appendOpsEntry`.
 */

import type {
  ExtensionAPI,
  SessionEntry,
} from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
import {
  extractContinuityDelta,
  isVisible,
  renderBriefing,
  type UserEntryRef,
} from "./continuity-briefing.ts";
import {
  applyOps,
  type ContinuityDelta,
  capText,
  createLedger,
  ITEM_ORIGINS,
  type ItemOrigin,
  LEDGER_DETAILS_KEY,
  type Ledger,
  type LedgerOp,
  parseLedger,
  reconcileFold,
  serializeLedger,
} from "./continuity-ledger.ts";

export const CONTINUITY_OPS_CUSTOM_TYPE = "navigate-tree-continuity-ops";

/** Token budget of the briefing embedded in a fold's handoff. */
export const FOLD_BRIEFING_MAX_TOKENS = 2500;

/** An op as persisted; the context keeps only its serializable fields. */
export interface StoredOp {
  readonly op: LedgerOp;
  readonly ctx: { readonly origin: ItemOrigin; readonly entryId?: string };
}

/** `data` of a `navigate-tree-continuity-ops` entry. */
export interface ContinuityOpsData {
  readonly ops: readonly StoredOp[];
  /** Capture cursor: the last session entry the ops were derived from. */
  readonly watermark?: string;
}

export interface BranchLedger {
  readonly ledger: Ledger;
  /** Last watermark in an ops entry after the last snapshot. */
  readonly watermark?: string;
  /** Entries that could not be applied; the previous ledger was kept. */
  readonly warnings: readonly string[];
}

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

const messageOf = (error: unknown): string =>
  error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);

const isUserMessage = (entry: SessionEntry): boolean =>
  entry.type === "message" && entry.message.role === "user";

/**
 * Resolver the ledger's citation check needs: the position of a user message
 * entry on `branch`, or undefined for a non-user or unknown id.
 */
export function userEntryIndexOf(
  branch: readonly SessionEntry[],
): (entryId: string) => number | undefined {
  const positions = new Map<string, number>();
  branch.forEach((entry, index) => {
    if (isUserMessage(entry)) positions.set(entry.id, index);
  });
  return (entryId) => positions.get(entryId);
}

function parseOpsData(data: unknown): ContinuityOpsData {
  if (!isRecord(data) || !Array.isArray(data.ops)) {
    throw new Error("expected { ops: [...] }");
  }
  if (data.watermark !== undefined && typeof data.watermark !== "string") {
    throw new Error("watermark must be a string");
  }
  for (const stored of data.ops as unknown[]) {
    if (
      !isRecord(stored) ||
      !isRecord(stored.op) ||
      typeof stored.op.op !== "string" ||
      !isRecord(stored.ctx) ||
      !ITEM_ORIGINS.includes(stored.ctx.origin as ItemOrigin) ||
      (stored.ctx.entryId !== undefined &&
        typeof stored.ctx.entryId !== "string")
    ) {
      throw new Error("malformed op");
    }
  }
  return data as unknown as ContinuityOpsData;
}

/**
 * Replay the ledger of a branch, root to leaf. Ops entries run through
 * `applyOps` (consecutive ops with one context are one revision); a snapshot on a
 * branch_summary replaces the running ledger. An unusable entry is reported in
 * `warnings` and skipped, never reset to an empty ledger.
 */
export function readBranchLedger(
  branch: readonly SessionEntry[],
): BranchLedger {
  const userEntryIndex = userEntryIndexOf(branch);
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  let ledger = createLedger();
  let watermark: string | undefined;
  for (const entry of branch) {
    if (entry.type === "branch_summary") {
      if (!isRecord(entry.details) || !(LEDGER_DETAILS_KEY in entry.details)) {
        continue;
      }
      try {
        ledger = parseLedger(entry.details[LEDGER_DETAILS_KEY]);
        watermark = undefined;
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(
          `branch_summary ${entry.id}: ledger snapshot ignored (${messageOf(error)})`,
        );
      }
    } else if (
      entry.type === "custom" &&
      entry.customType === CONTINUITY_OPS_CUSTOM_TYPE
    ) {
      try {
        const data = parseOpsData(entry.data);
        let next = ledger;
        for (const group of groupByContext(data.ops)) {
          next = applyOps(next, group.ops, {
            ...group.ctx,
            userEntryIndex,
          }).ledger;
        }
        ledger = next;
        if (data.watermark !== undefined) watermark = data.watermark;
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(
          `custom entry ${entry.id}: ops ignored (${messageOf(error)})`,
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return { ledger, ...(watermark !== undefined && { watermark }), warnings };
}

function groupByContext(
  ops: readonly StoredOp[],
): { ctx: StoredOp["ctx"]; ops: LedgerOp[] }[] {
  const groups: { ctx: StoredOp["ctx"]; ops: LedgerOp[] }[] = [];
  for (const stored of ops) {
    const last = groups.at(-1);
    if (
      last &&
      last.ctx.origin === stored.ctx.origin &&
      last.ctx.entryId === stored.ctx.entryId
    ) {
      last.ops.push(stored.op);
    } else {
      groups.push({ ctx: stored.ctx, ops: [stored.op] });
    }
  }
  return groups;
}

/** Persist ops on the active branch. Nothing is written when there is nothing to record. */
export function appendOpsEntry(
  pi: Pick<ExtensionAPI, "appendEntry">,
  ops: readonly StoredOp[],
  watermark?: string,
): void {
  if (ops.length === 0 && watermark === undefined) return;
  const data: ContinuityOpsData = {
    ops: ops.map(({ op, ctx }) => ({
      op,
      ctx: {
        origin: ctx.origin,
        ...(ctx.entryId !== undefined && { entryId: ctx.entryId }),
      },
    })),
    ...(watermark !== undefined && { watermark }),
  };
  pi.appendEntry(CONTINUITY_OPS_CUSTOM_TYPE, data);
}

const PREVIEW_SOURCE_CHARS = 400;

function userText(content: unknown): string {
  if (typeof content === "string") return content;
  if (!Array.isArray(content)) return "";
  return content
    .flatMap((block: unknown) =>
      isRecord(block) && block.type === "text" && typeof block.text === "string"
        ? [block.text]
        : [],
    )
    .join(" ");
}

/** User messages after `afterEntryId` on `branch`, with one-line previews the model can cite. */
export function spanUserEntryRefs(
  branch: readonly SessionEntry[],
  afterEntryId: string,
): UserEntryRef[] {
  const start = branch.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === afterEntryId);
  if (start < 0) return [];
  return branch.slice(start + 1).flatMap((entry) =>
    entry.type === "message" && entry.message.role === "user"
      ? [
          {
            id: entry.id,
            preview: userText(entry.message.content)
              .slice(0, PREVIEW_SOURCE_CHARS)
              .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
              .trim(),
          },
        ]
      : [],
  );
}

/** What a fold did to the ledger, for the continuation message's `details.continuity`. */
export interface FoldContinuityReport {
  readonly rev: number;
  readonly applied: number;
  readonly rejected: readonly { id?: string; reason: string }[];
  readonly evicted: readonly string[];
  readonly deltaError?: string;
  readonly warnings?: readonly string[];
}

export interface FoldContinuity {
  /** The model's summary with its `<continuity-delta>` block removed. */
  readonly summaryText: string;
  readonly ledger: Ledger;
  /** Rendered briefing; absent when nothing in the ledger is in force. */
  readonly briefing?: string;
  /** Validated plain-JSON ledger for `branch_summary.details`; absent for an empty ledger. */
  readonly snapshot?: Ledger;
  /** Absent when the ledger was empty and the model proposed nothing. */
  readonly report?: FoldContinuityReport;
  /** One visible line for the continuation, only when something was refused or evicted. */
  readonly notice?: string;
}

const MAX_NOTICE_REASONS = 3;
const NOTICE_REASON_CHARS = 160;

function noticeOf(
  report: FoldContinuityReport,
  rejected: readonly string[],
): string | undefined {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (rejected.length > 0) {
    const shown = rejected.slice(0, MAX_NOTICE_REASONS).join("; ");
    const more = rejected.length > MAX_NOTICE_REASONS ? "; ..." : "";
    parts.push(
      `${rejected.length} delta op${rejected.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} rejected (${shown}${more})`,
    );
  }
  if (report.evicted.length > 0) {
    parts.push(
      `${report.evicted.length} finished item${report.evicted.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} evicted at the ledger cap`,
    );
  }
  if (report.deltaError !== undefined) {
    parts.push(`delta ignored (${report.deltaError})`);
  }
  return parts.length > 0
    ? `Continuity: ${parts.join("; ")}.`.replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    : undefined;
}

/**
 * Fold-time reconciliation, with no model call: strip the model's optional
 * `<continuity-delta>` from its summary, apply it as an agent proposal (user
 * rules, decisions and the objective stay protected), archive the anchor's
 * steering, and render the briefing. A malformed delta is reported and nothing
 * from it is applied. `branch` is the active branch before the fold.
 */
export function reconcileFoldContinuity(
  branch: readonly SessionEntry[],
  summaryText: string,
  anchorName: string,
): FoldContinuity {
  const base = readBranchLedger(branch);
  const extracted = extractContinuityDelta(summaryText);
  if (
    base.ledger.items.length === 0 &&
    extracted.delta === undefined &&
    extracted.error === undefined &&
    base.warnings.length === 0
  ) {
    return { summaryText: extracted.text, ledger: base.ledger };
  }
  const delta: ContinuityDelta = extracted.delta ?? {};
  const result = reconcileFold(base.ledger, delta, {
    anchorName,
    origin: "agent",
    userEntryIndex: userEntryIndexOf(branch),
  });
  const reasons = result.rejected.map(({ reason }) =>
    capText(reason.message, NOTICE_REASON_CHARS),
  );
  const report: FoldContinuityReport = {
    rev: result.ledger.rev,
    applied: result.applied.length,
    rejected: result.rejected.map(({ reason }) => ({
      ...(reason.itemId !== undefined && { id: reason.itemId }),
      reason: reason.message,
    })),
    evicted: result.evicted,
    ...(extracted.error !== undefined && {
      deltaError: extracted.error.message,
    }),
    ...(base.warnings.length > 0 && { warnings: base.warnings }),
  };
  const ledger = result.ledger;
  const notice = noticeOf(report, reasons);
  return {
    summaryText: extracted.text,
    ledger,
    ...(ledger.items.some(isVisible) && {
      briefing: renderBriefing(ledger, { maxTokens: FOLD_BRIEFING_MAX_TOKENS })
        .text,
    }),
    ...(ledger.items.length > 0 && { snapshot: serializeLedger(ledger) }),
    report,
    ...(notice !== undefined && { notice }),
  };
}

import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { realpathSync } from "node:fs";
import { open, readdir, readFile, realpath } from "node:fs/promises";
import { basename, dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
import type { SessionHeader } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";

/** An immutable-body source snapshot, bound to the complete source bytes. */
export interface DescendantSnapshot {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly sha256: string;
  readonly header: SessionHeader;
  readonly body: Buffer;
}

function hash(bytes: Buffer): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
}

function record(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function header(value: unknown, path: string): SessionHeader {
  if (
    !record(value) ||
    value.type !== "session" ||
    value.version !== 3 ||
    typeof value.id !== "string" ||
    !value.id.trim() ||
    typeof value.timestamp !== "string" ||
    !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value.timestamp)) ||
    typeof value.cwd !== "string" ||
    !value.cwd.trim() ||
    (value.parentSession !== undefined &&
      (typeof value.parentSession !== "string" || !value.parentSession.trim()))
  )
    throw new Error(`Invalid session header/version: ${path}`);
  return {
    ...value,
    type: "session",
    version: value.version,
    id: value.id,
    timestamp: value.timestamp,
    cwd: value.cwd,
    parentSession: value.parentSession,
  };
}

async function firstLine(path: string): Promise<unknown> {
  const file = await open(path, "r");
  try {
    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
    const chunk = Buffer.alloc(1024);
    for (;;) {
      const { bytesRead } = await file.read(chunk);
      if (!bytesRead) break;
      const end = chunk.subarray(0, bytesRead).indexOf(10);
      chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk.subarray(0, end < 0 ? bytesRead : end)));
      if (end >= 0) break;
    }
    return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8"));
  } finally {
    await file.close();
  }
}

/** Relative parentSession links resolve from the owning file's directory, never cwd. */
function parentPath(path: string, parent: string): string {
  return realpathSync(resolve(dirname(path), parent));
}

/** Discover only path-linked descendants within bounded session-store directories. */
export async function discoverDescendantSessions(
  sourcePath: string,
  searchRoot?: string,
): Promise<DescendantSnapshot[]> {
  const source = await realpath(sourcePath);
  const root = searchRoot ? await realpath(searchRoot) : dirname(source);
  const encoded = (name: string) =>
    name.startsWith("--") && name.endsWith("--");
  const scope =
    !searchRoot &&
    encoded(basename(root)) &&
    basename(dirname(root)) === "sessions"
      ? dirname(root)
      : root;
  const directories = [root];
  for (const entry of await readdir(scope, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (entry.isDirectory() && encoded(entry.name))
      directories.push(join(scope, entry.name));
  }
  const candidates = new Map<string, { raw: unknown; parent?: string }>();
  for (const directory of new Set(directories)) {
    for (const entry of await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      if (
        (!entry.isFile() && !entry.isSymbolicLink()) ||
        !entry.name.endsWith(".jsonl")
      )
        continue;
      try {
        const path = await realpath(join(directory, entry.name));
        if (candidates.has(path)) continue;
        const raw = await firstLine(path);
        let parent: string | undefined;
        if (record(raw) && typeof raw.parentSession === "string") {
          try {
            parent = parentPath(path, raw.parentSession);
          } catch {
            /* Orphan links cannot select a descendant. */
          }
        }
        candidates.set(path, { raw, parent });
      } catch {
        /* Unrelated malformed files are not sessions in this family. */
      }
    }
  }
  const rootHeader = header(await firstLine(source), source);
  const selected = new Set([source]);
  const ordered: string[] = [];
  for (;;) {
    let added = false;
    for (const [path, candidate] of candidates) {
      if (
        !selected.has(path) &&
        candidate.parent &&
        selected.has(candidate.parent)
      ) {
        selected.add(path);
        ordered.push(path);
        added = true;
      }
    }
    if (!added) break;
  }
  let rootParent: string | undefined;
  if (rootHeader.parentSession) {
    try {
      rootParent = parentPath(source, rootHeader.parentSession);
    } catch {
      /* The root may have an unavailable parent. */
    }
  }
  if (rootParent && selected.has(rootParent))
    throw new Error("Cycle in selected session family");
  const ids = new Set([rootHeader.id]);
  const result: DescendantSnapshot[] = [];
  for (const path of ordered) {
    const bytes = await readFile(path);
    const end = bytes.indexOf(10);
    if (end < 0) throw new Error(`Missing session header newline: ${path}`);
    const parsed = header(
      JSON.parse(bytes.subarray(0, end).toString("utf8")),
      path,
    );
    const candidate = candidates.get(path);
    if (JSON.stringify(parsed) !== JSON.stringify(candidate?.raw))
      throw new Error(`Source changed during discovery: ${path}`);
    if (ids.has(parsed.id))
      throw new Error(`Duplicate session ID: ${parsed.id}`);
    ids.add(parsed.id);
    result.push({
      path,
      sha256: hash(bytes),
      header: parsed,
      body: Buffer.from(bytes.subarray(end + 1)),
    });
  }
  return result;
}

/** Plan new headers and filenames without writing or changing transcript bodies. */
export function planDescendantCopies(
  snapshots: readonly DescendantSnapshot[],
  rootSourcePath: string,
  rootClonePath: string,
): Array<{
  source: DescendantSnapshot;
  path: string;
  sessionId: string;
  bytes: Buffer;
}> {
  const paths = new Map([
    [realpathSync(rootSourcePath), resolve(rootClonePath)],
  ]);
  return snapshots.map((source) => {
    const parent = source.header.parentSession;
    const parentSession = parent && paths.get(parentPath(source.path, parent));
    if (!parentSession || paths.has(source.path))
      throw new Error(`Unordered or duplicate descendant: ${source.path}`);
    const sessionId = randomUUID();
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const path = join(
      dirname(source.path),
      `${timestamp.replace(/[:.]/g, "-")}_${sessionId}.jsonl`,
    );
    paths.set(source.path, path);
    const newHeader = {
      ...source.header,
      id: sessionId,
      timestamp,
      parentSession,
    };
    return {
      source,
      path,
      sessionId,
      bytes: Buffer.concat([
        Buffer.from(`${JSON.stringify(newHeader)}\n`),
        source.body,
      ]),
    };
  });
}

import {
  BranchSummaryMessageComponent,
  type ExtensionAPI,
  keyText,
  type SessionEntry,
  type Theme,
  TreeSelectorComponent,
} from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
import {
  Container,
  Markdown,
  MouseRegion,
  Text,
  truncateToWidth,
  wrapTextWithAnsi,
} from "@earendil-works/pi-tui";
import { getHandoff, type HandoffData, makeHandoff } from "./handoff.ts";

type Summary = Extract<SessionEntry, { type: "branch_summary" }>;

/** Resolve owned persisted summaries without changing the session projection. */
export function handoffView(
  entry: Summary,
  entries: readonly SessionEntry[],
  visiting = new Set<string>(),
): HandoffData | undefined {
  const data = getHandoff(entry);
  if (data) return data;
  if (
    visiting.has(entry.id) ||
    (typeof entry.details === "object" &&
      entry.details !== null &&
      "treeNavigator" in entry.details)
  )
    return undefined;
  const label = entries.findLast(
    (item) => item.type === "label" && item.targetId === entry.id,
  );
  if (
    !entry.fromHook ||
    label?.type !== "label" ||
    !label.label?.startsWith("anchor:")
  )
    return undefined;
  visiting.add(entry.id);
  const byId = new Map(entries.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
  const sources = new Set<string>();
  const children: string[] = [];
  const include = (item: SessionEntry) => {
    sources.add(item.id);
    if (item.type !== "branch_summary") return;
    const child = handoffView(item, entries, visiting);
    if (!child) return;
    children.push(item.id);
    for (const id of child.sourceIds) sources.add(id);
  };
  const details = entry.details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  const first = entries.findIndex((item) => item.id === details?.firstEntryId);
  const last = entries.findIndex((item) => item.id === details?.lastEntryId);
  if (details?.retrospective === true && first >= 0 && last >= first) {
    for (const item of entries.slice(first, last + 1)) include(item);
  } else {
    const walked = new Set<string>();
    let cursor = byId.get(entry.fromId);
    while (cursor && cursor.id !== entry.parentId && !walked.has(cursor.id)) {
      walked.add(cursor.id);
      include(cursor);
      cursor = cursor.parentId ? byId.get(cursor.parentId) : undefined;
    }
  }
  visiting.delete(entry.id);
  return makeHandoff({
    name: label.label.slice("anchor:".length),
    report: entry.summary,
    mode: "full",
    children: [...new Set(children)],
    sourceEntries: entries.filter((item) => sources.has(item.id)),
  });
}

/** `1.2k` / `3.4M` style count. */
export function compactCount(n: number): string {
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(n);
}

/** Compact inclusive accounting, shared by transcript cards and native tree rows. */
export function handoffUsage(data: HandoffData): string {
  const s = data.stats;
  return `${s.messages} messages · ${s.toolCalls} tool calls · tokens in ${compactCount(s.input)} / out ${compactCount(s.output)} / cache read ${compactCount(s.cacheRead)} / write ${compactCount(s.cacheWrite)} · recorded inclusive $${s.cost.toFixed(4)}`;
}

/** Native tree row body; the native list still owns selection and clipping. */
export function handoffRow(data: HandoffData): string {
  return `${data.title} — ${data.outcome} · ${handoffUsage(data)}`.replace(
    /\s+/g,
    " ",
  );
}

/** Build a themed card body; the native component retains expansion state. */
export function handoffCard(
  data: HandoffData,
  stored: string,
  expanded: boolean,
  theme: Theme,
  markdownTheme: ConstructorParameters<typeof Markdown>[3],
): Container {
  const body = new Container();
  body.addChild(
    new Text(theme.fg("customMessageLabel", theme.bold(data.title)), 0, 0),
  );
  for (const text of [`Goal: ${data.goal}`, `Outcome: ${data.outcome}`]) {
    body.addChild({
      render(width) {
        if (width <= 0) return [];
        const lines = wrapTextWithAnsi(
          theme.fg("customMessageText", text),
          width,
        );
        if (expanded || lines.length <= 3) return lines;
        const kept = lines.slice(0, 3);
        kept[2] = truncateToWidth(`${kept[2]} …`, width);
        return kept;
      },
      invalidate() {},
    });
  }
  body.addChild(new Text(theme.fg("muted", handoffUsage(data)), 0, 0));
  body.addChild(
    new Text(
      theme.fg(
        "dim",
        `${keyText("app.tools.expand")} to ${expanded ? "collapse" : "expand"}`,
      ),
      0,
      0,
    ),
  );
  if (expanded) {
    body.addChild(
      new Text(
        theme.fg(
          "muted",
          `Child context: ${data.mode === "full" ? "full reports" : "parent synthesis only"} · ${data.children.length} child handoffs`,
        ),
        0,
        0,
      ),
    );
    body.addChild(new Markdown(stored, 0, 0, markdownTheme));
  }
  return body;
}

type NativeCard = {
  message: { fromId: string; summary: string };
  expanded: boolean;
  markdownTheme: ConstructorParameters<typeof Markdown>[3];
  clear(): void;
  addChild(child: MouseRegion): void;
  setExpanded(expanded: boolean): void;
};
type Hook = (this: NativeCard, ...args: unknown[]) => unknown;
const patchKey = Symbol.for("pi-tree-navigator.handoff-renderer.original");
type PatchedHook = Hook & { [patchKey]?: Hook };

function patch(
  prototype: Record<string, unknown>,
  key: string,
  wrap: (original: Hook) => Hook,
): () => void {
  const previous = prototype[key];
  if (typeof previous !== "function") throw new Error(`Missing native ${key}`);
  const original = (previous as PatchedHook)[patchKey] ?? (previous as Hook);
  const replacement: PatchedHook = wrap(original);
  replacement[patchKey] = original;
  prototype[key] = replacement;
  return () => {
    if (prototype[key] === replacement) prototype[key] = original;
  };
}

/** Install reversible, reload-safe native hooks against a current session lookup. */
export function installHandoffPatches(options: {
  entries: () => readonly SessionEntry[];
  theme: () => Theme;
  warn: () => void;
}): () => void {
  const restores: (() => void)[] = [];
  let warned = false;
  const warn = () => {
    if (warned) return;
    warned = true;
    options.warn();
  };
  try {
    restores.push(
      patch(
        BranchSummaryMessageComponent.prototype as unknown as Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >,
        "updateDisplay",
        (original) =>
          function (...args) {
            try {
              if (
                !this.message ||
                typeof this.setExpanded !== "function" ||
                typeof this.clear !== "function" ||
                typeof this.addChild !== "function" ||
                typeof this.expanded !== "boolean"
              )
                throw new Error("Native card shape changed");
              const entries = options.entries();
              const matches = entries.filter(
                (entry): entry is Summary =>
                  entry.type === "branch_summary" &&
                  entry.fromId === this.message.fromId &&
                  entry.summary === this.message.summary,
              );
              const data =
                matches.length === 1
                  ? handoffView(matches[0], entries)
                  : undefined;
              if (data) {
                const body = handoffCard(
                  data,
                  this.message.summary,
                  this.expanded,
                  options.theme(),
                  this.markdownTheme,
                );
                this.clear();
                this.addChild(
                  new MouseRegion(body, (event) => {
                    if (event.type !== "click" || event.button !== "left")
                      return undefined;
                    this.setExpanded(!this.expanded);
                    return { handled: true };
                  }),
                );
                return;
              }
            } catch {
              warn();
            }
            return original.apply(this, args);
          },
      ),
    );
    const selector = new TreeSelectorComponent(
      [],
      null,
      1,
      () => {},
      () => {},
    );
    const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(selector.getTreeList()) as Record<
      string,
      unknown
    >;
    restores.push(
      patch(
        prototype,
        "getEntryDisplayText",
        (original) =>
          function (...args) {
            try {
              const node = args[0] as { entry?: SessionEntry } | undefined;
              if (node?.entry?.type === "branch_summary") {
                const entries = options.entries();
                const entry = entries.find(
                  (item) => item.id === node.entry?.id,
                );
                const data =
                  entry?.type === "branch_summary"
                    ? handoffView(entry, entries)
                    : undefined;
                if (data) {
                  const theme = options.theme();
                  const text = theme.fg("customMessageLabel", handoffRow(data));
                  return args[1] ? theme.bold(text) : text;
                }
              }
            } catch {
              warn();
            }
            return original.apply(this, args);
          },
      ),
    );
  } catch {
    warn();
  }
  return () => {
    for (const restore of restores.reverse()) restore();
  };
}

/** Register session-scoped native rendering without changing persisted or model data. */
export function registerHandoffRenderer(pi: ExtensionAPI): void {
  let dispose: (() => void) | undefined;
  pi.on("session_start", (_event, ctx) => {
    dispose?.();
    if (!ctx.hasUI || ctx.mode !== "tui") return;
    dispose = installHandoffPatches({
      entries: () => ctx.sessionManager.getEntries(),
      theme: () => ctx.ui.theme,
      warn: () =>
        ctx.ui.notify(
          "Tree navigator native handoff display is incompatible; using native rendering where unavailable.",
          "warning",
        ),
    });
  });
  pi.on("session_shutdown", () => {
    dispose?.();
    dispose = undefined;
  });
}

/**
 * Pure helpers for the navigate-tree extension.
 *
 * Imported by `./index.ts` and `./helpers.test.ts`. Pi's extension loader
 * loads `./index.ts` and ignores everything else in this directory unless
 * referenced from there — so this file isn't loaded as a separate extension.
 *
 * No pi runtime imports — these are pure functions over plain JS values.
 */

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Exported boundary constants below (TOOL_NAME, MAX_NAME_LENGTH,
// MAX_BOILERPLATE_LEAD_IN).
//
// Stability: these are internal tunables. Exported only so the test suite
// can pin boundary cases by constant rather than literal. Re-tuning is
// NOT a semver-breaking change for this package — production callers
// should rely on the registered `navigate_tree` tool surface, not import
// these constants directly.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// The registered tool name. Lives here (not index.ts) so the tool definition
// and the rewind-hint copy builders import the same string — a rename can't
// desync the `[navigate_tree hint]` copy from the tool the model calls.
export const TOOL_NAME = "navigate_tree";

/**
 * The user message `/anchor` injects to ask the agent for a fold. Continuity
 * capture skips it by pattern (`FOLD_REQUEST_RE`), so the wording is shared and
 * the optional `focus` only ever extends the text after the matched prefix.
 */
export function buildFoldRequestText(
  anchorName: string,
  newLabel: string,
  minFocusLength: number,
  focus?: string,
): string {
  const request = `Please fold the work since the '${anchorName}' anchor: call ${TOOL_NAME}(action='rewind', rewindTo='${anchorName}', newLabel='${newLabel}'), with a summaryFocus of at least ${minFocusLength} characters covering my latest instruction, what is done since that anchor and what remains.`;
  if (focus === undefined) return request;
  const escaped = focus.replace(/[\\"]/g, "\\$&");
  return `${request} Use this summaryFocus: "${escaped}"`;
}

// Reserved label prefix shared by anchor/rewind labels. Lives here (not
// index.ts) so the tool description, the tool handlers, and the rewind-hint
// copy builders can't desync on a rename.
export const LABEL_PREFIX = "anchor:";

// Reserved label prefix for the rewind-completion marker (#90): a successful
// rewind labels its summary turn (the abandoned branch's last real entry)
// `branch:<newLabel>`, so `/tree` can jump back to the collapsed segment and
// the restart check knows that rewind finished. Never resolved by `rewindTo`
// and never listed by `list`.
export const BRANCH_LABEL_PREFIX = "branch:";

// Hard cap on label-name length. 40 chars accommodates descriptive names
// (e.g. 'parser-edge-case-investigation', 31 chars) while keeping list
// output column-friendly under common terminal widths and preventing a
// runaway label string from poisoning the JSONL on disk.
export const MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 40;
/**
 * Kebab-case anchor name: lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by
 * single hyphens. No leading / trailing / double hyphens (the `isValidName`
 * test suite enforces these rejections). Mirrors the pattern documented in
 * the tool description and README — if this regex relaxes, both surfaces
 * need the same update.
 */
const NAME_RE = /^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;

// Maximum lead-in distance for pi's branch-summary boilerplate marker.
// Pi's standard prelude ("The user explored a different conversation
// branch...") fits in the first ~150 chars; 200 is a generous upper bound.
// A "## Goal" found later than this is treated as in-content prose, not
// the boilerplate marker, and the strip is a no-op.
export const MAX_BOILERPLATE_LEAD_IN = 200;

// Sentinel that pi's branch-summary prelude always starts with. Gating
// the strip on this prefix makes the helper a no-op for any non-
// boilerplate text that happens to contain `## Goal` early (e.g. a
// user-authored markdown doc whose first H2 is "Goal"). Verified
// against pi 0.75.5's `dist/core/compaction/branch-summarization.js`;
// if pi reworks the prelude wording, the strip falls back to a no-op
// (`findLabelHint` shows the unmodified prelude). Verify when bumping
// the peer-dep floor.
const BRANCH_SUMMARY_SENTINEL =
  "The user explored a different conversation branch";

// Pi 0.75.5's branch-summary boilerplate places `## Goal` after the prelude
// (verified against `dist/core/compaction/branch-summarization.js`). Used to
// anchor the strip cut-point in `stripBranchSummaryBoilerplate` — a single
// constant so the indexOf probe and the slice-length advance can't drift.
const GOAL_HEADER = "## Goal";

/** Validate a kebab-case name suitable for use as a navigate-tree label. */
export function isValidName(s: unknown): s is string {
  return (
    typeof s === "string" &&
    s.length > 0 &&
    s.length <= MAX_NAME_LENGTH &&
    NAME_RE.test(s)
  );
}

/** Truncate text to a one-line preview, collapsing whitespace. */
export function toOneLine(text: string, maxLen: number): string | null {
  const t = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return null;
  if (maxLen <= 1) return t.length > 0 ? "…" : null;
  return t.length > maxLen ? `${t.slice(0, maxLen - 1)}…` : t;
}

/**
 * Format token count as a percentage with one decimal, or as `Nk` if no window.
 */
export function formatPct1(tokens: number, contextWindow: number): string {
  if (contextWindow <= 0) return `${(tokens / 1000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return `${((tokens / contextWindow) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
}

/** Format a context window size as `1.0M` or `200k`. Empty string when unknown. */
export function formatWindow(contextWindow: number): string {
  if (contextWindow <= 0) return "";
  if (contextWindow >= 1_000_000)
    return `${(contextWindow / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  return `${(contextWindow / 1000).toFixed(0)}k`;
}

export function formatContextDelta(
  beforeTokens: number,
  afterTokens: number,
  contextWindow: number,
): string {
  if (contextWindow > 0) {
    return `context ${formatPct1(beforeTokens, contextWindow)} → ${formatPct1(afterTokens, contextWindow)} of ${formatWindow(contextWindow)}`;
  }
  return `tokens ${beforeTokens} → ${afterTokens}`;
}

/**
 * Strip pi's standard branch-summary boilerplate ("The user explored a
 * different conversation branch...") so the hint shows the actual content.
 */
export function stripBranchSummaryBoilerplate(text: string): string {
  if (!text.startsWith(BRANCH_SUMMARY_SENTINEL)) return text;
  const goalIdx = text.indexOf(GOAL_HEADER);
  if (goalIdx > 0 && goalIdx < MAX_BOILERPLATE_LEAD_IN) {
    return text.slice(goalIdx + GOAL_HEADER.length);
  }
  return text;
}

/**
 * Extract a string from a message-like content field. Handles both the
 * legacy string shape and the modern array-of-blocks shape, joining all
 * text blocks with spaces.
 */
export function extractTextContent(content: unknown): string {
  if (typeof content === "string") return content;
  if (!Array.isArray(content)) return "";
  return content
    .filter(
      (c): c is { type: "text"; text: string } =>
        typeof c === "object" &&
        c !== null &&
        (c as { type?: string }).type === "text" &&
        typeof (c as { text?: unknown }).text === "string",
    )
    .map((c) => c.text)
    .join(" ");
}

/** One row of the active-anchor table (#101, D19). */
export interface AnchorTableRow {
  /** Cumulative context at the anchor, as `formatPct1` renders it. */
  pct: string;
  name: string;
  /** `list` only: a preview of the entry the anchor sits on. */
  after?: string;
}

/**
 * The active-anchor table shared by `list`, the rewind hint, the min-savings
 * refusal and the forced-rewind message (#101, D19):
 *
 * ```
 * Active anchors (root → leaf, % of 100k):
 *    4.1%  start
 *   12.0%  context-gathered
 * ```
 *
 * The percent column is as wide as its widest cell (at least 5, so
 * `100.0%` keeps the names aligned). Only when a row has `after` are names
 * padded (to the longest name, capped at `MAX_NAME_LENGTH`), so rows never
 * end in spaces.
 */
export function formatAnchorTable(
  rows: readonly AnchorTableRow[],
  contextWindow: number,
): string {
  const header =
    contextWindow > 0
      ? `Active anchors (root → leaf, % of ${formatWindow(contextWindow)}):`
      : "Active anchors (root → leaf):";
  const pctWidth = Math.max(5, ...rows.map((r) => r.pct.length));
  const withAfter = rows.some((r) => r.after !== undefined);
  const nameWidth = withAfter
    ? Math.min(MAX_NAME_LENGTH, Math.max(0, ...rows.map((r) => r.name.length)))
    : 0;
  const lines = rows.map((r) => {
    const cells = `  ${r.pct.padStart(pctWidth)}  `;
    return r.after !== undefined
      ? `${cells}${r.name.padEnd(nameWidth)}  (after: “${r.after}”)`
      : `${cells}${r.name}`;
  });
  return [header, ...lines].join("\n");
}

interface CapturedTool {
  name: string;

  parameters: Record<string, unknown>;
  executionMode?: string;
  execute: (
    toolCallId: string,
    params: unknown,
    signal: AbortSignal | undefined,

    content: Array<{ type: "text"; text: string }>;

    isError?: boolean;
  }>;

}

interface FakePi {
  pi: ExtensionAPI;
  setLabelCalls: Array<[string, string | undefined]>;
  registered: CapturedTool[];
  commands: Map<string, Parameters<ExtensionAPI["registerCommand"]>[1]>;
  /** Captured `on(event, handler)` registrations, keyed by event name. */
  onCalls: Map<string, Array<(e: never, c: never) => unknown>>;
  /**
   * Raw argument arrays for every `sendMessage` call. Storing the full args
   * (not just the message object) is deliberate: the rewind hint's pinned
   * contract is a ONE-argument call (no options bag). Rewind messages never
   * go through `sendMessage`: they are `turn_end` boundary entries.
   */
  sendMessageCalls: unknown[][];
  /**
   * Raw argument arrays for every `sendUserMessage` call. Late input is
   * re-appended directly, never re-sent: tests pin this stays empty.
   */
  sendUserMessageCalls: unknown[][];
  /** Interleaved `sendMessage` / `sendUserMessage` call order. */
  sendLog: Array<"sendMessage" | "sendUserMessage">;
  /** Folded `turn_end` boundary results, one per `fireTurnEndAll`. */
  boundaryResults: BoundaryResult[];
  /** `appendEntry(customType, data)` calls (routed to `sm.appendCustomEntry`). */
  appendEntryCalls: Array<[string, unknown]>;
  /** `registerMessageRenderer` registrations, keyed by customType. */
  messageRenderers: Map<string, (...args: never[]) => unknown>;
  /** `registerEntryRenderer` registrations, keyed by customType. */
  entryRenderers: Map<string, (...args: never[]) => unknown>;
}

/**
 * A boundary entry draft (pi's `SessionBoundaryDraft` union, loosely typed):
 * `custom_message` (customType/content/display/details), `custom`
 * (customType/data), `context_edit` (targetId/replacement) or `compaction`.
 */
interface BoundaryDraft {
  type: string;
  customType: string;
  content: string;
  display: boolean;
  details: Record<string, unknown>;
  data?: Record<string, unknown>;
  targetId?: string;
  replacement?: { content: unknown } | null;
  summary?: string;
  firstKeptEntryId?: string | null;
}

/** The folded `turn_end` boundary result, as `emitBoundary` returns it. */
interface BoundaryResult {
  entries: BoundaryDraft[];

}

/**
 * Build a minimal fake ExtensionAPI. `registerTool` captures the registered
 * tool definition; `setLabel` writes through to the SessionManager so
 * `sm.getLabel(...)` reflects the current state. Other methods throw on
 * access \u2014 the tool's `execute` only touches `setLabel`, so unknown calls
 * indicate a contract drift the tests want to surface.
 */
function makeFakePi(sm: SessionManager): FakePi {
  const setLabelCalls: Array<[string, string | undefined]> = [];
  const registered: CapturedTool[] = [];
  const commands: FakePi["commands"] = new Map();
  const onCalls = new Map<string, Array<(e: never, c: never) => unknown>>();
  const sendMessageCalls: unknown[][] = [];
  const sendUserMessageCalls: unknown[][] = [];
  const sendLog: FakePi["sendLog"] = [];
  const boundaryResults: BoundaryResult[] = [];
  const appendEntryCalls: Array<[string, unknown]> = [];
  const messageRenderers = new Map<string, (...args: never[]) => unknown>();
  const entryRenderers = new Map<string, (...args: never[]) => unknown>();
  const pi = {
    appendEntry(customType: string, data?: unknown) {
      appendEntryCalls.push([customType, data]);
      sm.appendCustomEntry(customType, data);
    },
    registerMessageRenderer(
      customType: string,
      renderer: (...args: never[]) => unknown,
    ) {
      messageRenderers.set(customType, renderer);
    },
    registerEntryRenderer(
      customType: string,
      renderer: (...args: never[]) => unknown,
    ) {
      entryRenderers.set(customType, renderer);
    },
    registerTool(tool: CapturedTool) {
      registered.push(tool);
    },
    registerCommand(
      name: string,
      options: Parameters<ExtensionAPI["registerCommand"]>[1],
    ) {
      commands.set(name, options);
    },
    setLabel(entryId: string, label: string | undefined) {
      setLabelCalls.push([entryId, label]);
      // Route the label through the SessionManager so reads via
      // `sm.getLabel(...)` reflect the state the tool just set. Production
      // pi does this via the ExtensionRunner; in tests we shortcut.
      sm.appendLabelChange(entryId, label);
    },
    on(event: string, handler: (e: never, c: never) => unknown) {
      const list = onCalls.get(event) ?? [];
      list.push(handler);
      onCalls.set(event, list);
    },
    sendMessage(...args: unknown[]) {
      sendMessageCalls.push(args);
      sendLog.push("sendMessage");
    },
    sendUserMessage(...args: unknown[]) {
      sendUserMessageCalls.push(args);
      sendLog.push("sendUserMessage");
    },
  } as unknown as ExtensionAPI;
  return {
    pi,
    setLabelCalls,
    registered,
    onCalls,
    sendMessageCalls,
    sendUserMessageCalls,
    sendLog,
    boundaryResults,
    appendEntryCalls,
    messageRenderers,
    entryRenderers,
    commands,
  };
}
